bases.name: Janus Blades
bases.desc: ASTRA COLOR SHOXX / Dense sheaves of two-faced blades on a flow: a scarlet matte-lacquer face and a cobalt brushed-metal face split by a chrome spine.

bases.name: Chromatic Undertow
bases.desc: ASTRA COLOR SHOXX / Rip-current bands curl into hooks around hundreds of vortices, turquoise metal against vermilion enamel with pale eddy lips.

bases.name: Spectrum Guillotine
bases.desc: ASTRA COLOR SHOXX / Shutter slats sliced by guillotine cuts into shards knocked to new angles, lime lacquer and amethyst metal, every cut burning a spectrum.

bases.name: Chromatic Switchyard
bases.desc: ASTRA COLOR SHOXX / A switchyard drawn as a transit map: yellow-lacquer and cobalt-metal lanes with sleepers, 45-degree crossovers and white roundels.

bases.name: Bipolar Cyclone
bases.desc: ASTRA COLOR SHOXX / A weather map of small cyclones spinning both ways: ruby-lacquer and ice-metal spiral arms, chrome eyes and dark shear wakes.

bases.name: Prism Rebellion
bases.desc: ASTRA COLOR SHOXX / A shattered prism wall: warped triangular shards, some split finer, amber glass against violet metal, every edge dispersed into RGB.

bases.name: Dichroic Rivets
bases.desc: ASTRA COLOR SHOXX / Studded dichroic armour: hex-packed domed rivet heads shifting rose to gold to turquoise with slope, washers and empty sockets.

bases.name: Switchblade Chevron
bases.desc: ASTRA COLOR SHOXX / Chevron parquet in bands of random height, cobalt metal against gold lacquer, switchblade columns flipped open on chrome pins.

bases.name: Duality Scales
bases.desc: ASTRA COLOR SHOXX / Imbricated scales on curving rows, each with a lime-lacquer tip and a plum-metal root, a hidden field dithering which leads.

bases.name: Polarity Lace
bases.desc: ASTRA COLOR SHOXX / Lace woven from electrostatics: coral field-line threads and jade equipotential threads crossing in gold knots over navy openwork.

bases.name: Pipeline Royale
bases.desc: ASTRA SURFS UP / Rows of peeling surf barrels: navy trough to glassy green lip, white foam and spray, dark tubes opening under the throw.

bases.name: Reef Cathedral
bases.desc: ASTRA SURFS UP / Brain-coral naves from a reaction-diffusion labyrinth, coral ridges over teal grooves, star polyps and sunlit caustics.

bases.name: Tidal Lacework
bases.desc: ASTRA SURFS UP / The lace a retreating wave leaves: a thick white foam net torn open in patches over orange-gold sand and water that deepens from aqua to cobalt-indigo.

bases.name: Surf Wax Ritual
bases.desc: ASTRA SURFS UP / Fresh wax on a board: domed wax beads rubbed up in circles over a glowing tropical basecoat, comb crosshatch and sand grains.

bases.name: Wipeout Paisley
bases.desc: ASTRA SURFS UP / Psychedelic surf paisley: packed curled boteh at every size and angle, echo bands, beaded borders and inner eyes on a dot print.

bases.name: Kelp Couture
bases.desc: ASTRA SURFS UP / A kelp forest cut as couture: three depths of translucent ruffled ribbons with gold midribs, float pearls and sequin glints.

bases.name: Boardwalk Pinlines
bases.desc: ASTRA SURFS UP / A painted boardwalk: every plank a faded beach-hut colour with grain, wear-through and nails, coach-lined in its complement colour with cream clothoid sign-painter flourishes.

bases.name: Volcanic Break
bases.desc: ASTRA SURFS UP / A surf break over basalt: hexagonal column tops, lava glowing through hidden joints, teal tide in the low columns, foam at the waterline.

bases.name: Abyssal Lanterns
bases.desc: ASTRA SURFS UP / The deep lit only by its animals: amber, magenta and coral jellies with trailing tentacles, light chains and plankton sparks in polished indigo water.

bases.name: Sea Glass Confessional
bases.desc: ASTRA SURFS UP / A backlit confessional window of sea glass: saturated frosted pebbles in strong regional colour families (kelly, cobalt, amber, aqua), dark leading and a lattice screen shadow.

bases.name: Cytokinesis Candy
bases.desc: ASTRA MAD SCIENTIST / A tissue of hard-candy cells mid-mitosis: resting cells with speckled nuclei, dividing peanuts with two nuclei and glowing spindles.

bases.name: Quantum Petri Carnival
bases.desc: ASTRA MAD SCIENTIST / Bacterial colonies on amber agar: quantised growth rings, pinwheel cores, fractal fingering rims and clear inhibition zones.

bases.name: Chromosome Riot
bases.desc: ASTRA MAD SCIENTIST / A spectral karyotype rioting: X chromosomes at every angle, pinched centromeres, fluorescent hues, G-bands and telomere caps.

bases.name: Plasma Sutures
bases.desc: ASTRA MAD SCIENTIST / Incisions in an iridescent membrane stitched shut with violet-white plasma cross-stitches, Lichtenberg arcs and cauterised edges.

bases.name: Bismuth Delirium
bases.desc: ASTRA MAD SCIENTIST / An aggregate of bismuth hopper crystals: square stair-stepped spirals sinking to hollow centres in shifting oxide colours.

bases.name: Strange Attractor
bases.desc: ASTRA MAD SCIENTIST / Specimens of chaos: real Clifford and de Jong attractors iterated into glowing filament galaxies, rotated across a phase-space grid.

bases.name: Neuron Carnival
bases.desc: ASTRA MAD SCIENTIST / A Brainbow tangle: hundreds of neurons each its own fluorescent colour, glowing somata, three-level dendrites and bouton-studded axons.

bases.name: Xenobot Orchard
bases.desc: ASTRA MAD SCIENTIST / An orchard of xenobots: lime, cyan and hot-pink frog-cell spheres with Pac-Man mouths and cilia fringes on oxblood soil, with gold cell piles for their offspring.

bases.name: Fermion Foundry
bases.desc: ASTRA MAD SCIENTIST / A bubble chamber in a furnace: orange-gold and cyan tracks colour-coded by momentum curl into tightening spirals over glowing oxblood iron.

bases.name: Chromatic Centrifuge
bases.desc: ASTRA MAD SCIENTIST / Lathe-turned rotors carrying rings of sample tubes spun into density-gradient colour bands, pellets at the rim, polished hubs.

bases.name: Causal Origami
bases.desc: ASTRA FUTURE SHOXX / Miura-ori folded foil: alternating hot-magenta and teal fold columns in flowing regions, chrome mountain creases, a causal fold wave across the car.

bases.name: Photonic Switchboard
bases.desc: ASTRA FUTURE SHOXX / A silicon photonics wafer: 45-degree waveguides carrying coloured laser light, ring resonators, grating combs and die streets.

bases.name: Negative Space Engine
bases.desc: ASTRA FUTURE SHOXX / Blue-violet anodised titanium over a live engine: hole size traces hidden gear trains, copper light glowing and spilling through every perforation.

bases.name: Temporal Braille
bases.desc: ASTRA FUTURE SHOXX / A refreshable braille display the size of the car: six-dot pins spell text, each pin the complement of the backlit blue-to-violet-to-red panel beneath it.

bases.name: Klein Circuit
bases.desc: ASTRA FUTURE SHOXX / A circuit that loops back through itself: 45-degree gold buses on black mask, a lilac inner layer, vias, pads and Klein bridges.

bases.name: Auxetic Exoskin
bases.desc: ASTRA FUTURE SHOXX / A rotating-squares auxetic skin: bevelled gunmetal plates hinged corner to corner, a strain field opening glowing ember gaps.

bases.name: Memory Metal Zipper
bases.desc: ASTRA FUTURE SHOXX / Zippers on an exact conformal flow: heat-tinted nitinol teeth interlocking copper and silver on woven tape, some runs sprung open.

bases.name: Orbitless Navigation
bases.desc: ASTRA FUTURE SHOXX / A portolan chart with no orbits: hidden wind roses shoot 32 rhumb lines across a dark sea chart in gold, green and red.

bases.name: Tachyon Feather
bases.desc: ASTRA FUTURE SHOXX / Plumage faster than light: overlapping contour feathers with bright rachises and iridescent barbs, Cherenkov-blue tip streaks.

bases.name: Programmable Matter
bases.desc: ASTRA FUTURE SHOXX / An isometric field of voxel modules, faces lit three ways, colour-coded in programmed data tiles, empty slots and LED edges.

bases.name: Event Horizon
bases.desc: ASTRA ASTRA ORIGINALS / A field of tiny black holes: absorbing shadows, chrome photon rings, Doppler-bright accretion discs and polar jets over a lensed starfield.

bases.name: Quasicrystal Crown
bases.desc: ASTRA ASTRA ORIGINALS / Five-fold quasicrystal interference drawn as gold contour filigree over royal enamel, with ten-fold gold crowns and cabochon gems.

bases.name: Gravity Loom
bases.desc: ASTRA ASTRA ORIGINALS / A 2/2 twill of metallic silk pulled into gravity wells: threads bend, redshift and sink toward tiny stars ringed by Einstein rings.

bases.name: Phoenix Ceramic
bases.desc: ASTRA ASTRA ORIGINALS / Raku kintsugi: smoke-stained crackle inside a coarse fracture net, raised gold repair seams and copper-luster flame tongues.

bases.desc: ASTRA ASTRA ORIGINALS / Paua nacre: swirling interference colour, growth-line terraces every few pixels, a shimmering tablet mosaic and blister pearls.

bases.name: Magnetic Regalia
bases.desc: ASTRA ASTRA ORIGINALS / Ferrofluid under magnets: black-chrome Rosensweig spike crowns rise at the poles, gold iron-filing dashes trace every field line.

bases.name: Meteorite Royal
bases.desc: ASTRA ASTRA ORIGINALS / An etched iron meteorite: Widmanstaetten lamellae in three directions etched gold, royal blue and violet, each its own material, with taenite rims and plessite fill.

bases.name: Cryogenic Bloom
bases.desc: ASTRA ASTRA ORIGINALS / Six-fold ice dendrites bloom from hundreds of nuclei over crystalline rime, glassy ice against frost with cold violet plasma.

bases.name: Chronograph Gold
bases.desc: ASTRA ASTRA ORIGINALS / Watchmaker gold: panels engine-turned in six guilloche patterns, polished chamfers, ruby jewels in chatons and toothed wheels.

bases.name: Velvet Supernova
bases.desc: ASTRA ASTRA ORIGINALS / Plum panne velvet strewn with supernova remnants: knotty filament shells, synchrotron cores and diffraction-spiked neutron stars.

bases.name: Reticulated Python
bases.desc: A continuous pale copper net holds dark irregular armour blocks, each packed with fine keratin crescents, root pores and differently coated facets.

bases.name: Diamondback Armor
bases.desc: Pale bordered rhombs traverse a fine raised keel field: charcoal diamond centres, copper axial ribs, cream pointed collars and individually scarred scale faces.

bases.name: Boa Saddlework
bases.desc: Pinched dark saddles sit within copper-ivory hide, with scalloped keratin tesserae, cream saddle rims, dry waist trenches and minute basal freckles.

bases.name: Corn Snake Blotch
bases.desc: Unbroken dark outlines enclose burnt-scarlet saddles over fine orange belly checks, with pearled rims, tiny pigment pores and individually cut keratin tiles.

bases.name: Anaconda Oval
bases.desc: Staggered dark oval markings hold pale olive hearts across fine emerald hide, with offset eyelid rims, pore constellations and hooked keratin creases.

bases.name: Milk Snake Band
bases.desc: Ordered scarlet-black-ivory rings bend around fine transverse skin, with scalloped band seams, lacquered red ribs, dry black keratin and minute cream root pearls.

bases.name: Gaboon Geometric
bases.desc: Razor hourglasses and triangular flank marks tessellate through bronze-plum hide, divided by pale bevels, fine leaf-vein cuts and dry black root creases.

bases.name: Keeled Viper
bases.desc: Dense overlapping asymmetric spear scales form a complete copper-green skin; raised keels divide independently polished faces, with lapped edges, dry root shoulders, hooked tips, crossed dermal cuts and elongated pores.

bases.name: Sea Snake Gloss
bases.desc: Overlapping wet cycloid shells show fan striae, bright meniscus lips, dark basal pockets and pin-sized trapped droplets through blue-gold pearl.

bases.name: Cobra Hood Weave
bases.desc: Splayed hood ribs pull fine scales wide through cobalt-bronze silk, with paired vein seams, polished shoulder lips and dark flexible hinge roots.

bases.name: Ventral Scute
bases.desc: Wide transverse belly plates interlock through narrow side hinges: amber pearl faces, fine friction ribs, cream seam lips and rooted skin pores.

bases.name: Sidewinder Micro
bases.desc: Sand-adapted diamond granules have asymmetric windward polish, fine erosion pits, dry lee ridges and silica caught between small ochre-violet scales.

bases.name: Wart Snake Hide
bases.desc: Crowded irregular tubercles rise from violet hide, with copper worn crowns, dry granular collars, pearly satellite warts and tiny asymmetric skin fissures.

bases.name: Sunbeam Iridescence
bases.desc: Swept overlapping lance scales with dark roots, luminous interference faces, fine striae and individually polished trailing lips.

bases.name: Shed Skin Lace
bases.desc: Papery translucent scale ghosts form a dense ivory-violet lace: curled membrane lips, missing windows, dry wrinkle cuts and fine basal root rings.

bases.name: Albino Translucence
bases.desc: Living ivory-pink skin keeps its fine pigmentless scale ghosts, with translucent keratin veils, rose capillary roots, polished pearl lips and faint dry dermal cuts.

bases.name: Return Stroke
bases.desc: Stepped silver return channels race through ink-blue lacquer: narrow bright cores, copper ion collars, leader forks and etched shock bands.

bases.name: Lichtenberg Burn
bases.desc: A dense dielectric burn forest: black ramifying scars, copper ash collars and pale conductive veins embedded in amber-violet glass.

bases.name: Spider Crawl
bases.desc: Fine horizontal crawler fans braid through midnight turquoise: hooked side branches, conductive knots, matte scorch cuffs and tiny copper bridges.

bases.name: Beaded Lightning
bases.desc: A fading channel breaks into oblique pearl droplets: bright bead heads, copper tails, charcoal necks and tiny residual charge hairs over indigo lacquer.

bases.name: Tesla Streamer
bases.desc: Microscopic winding coils launch curled pearl streamers through burgundy lacquer: exposed coil turns, hooked terminals, dark insulation and copper feed vias.

bases.name: Plasma Globe
bases.desc: A densely tessellated glass plasma lens: winding inner filaments meet pink rim flashes, polished nuclei and fine etched lens sectors.

bases.name: St Elmo's Fire
bases.desc: Point-discharge brushwork over violet enamel: silver needle apices, cobalt corona ribs, copper guard collars and graded pearlescent discharge skirts.

bases.name: Corona Ring Lace
bases.desc: Interlocking fine copper coronas fringe a cyan ceramic lace: asymmetric oval guards, radial pearl streamlets, shield apertures and dark seated torus roots.

bases.name: Streamer Front
bases.desc: Fine comb-shaped discharge fronts overlap through amber glass: advancing pearl tips, copper precursor hooks, dark return trenches and graded charge skirts.

bases.name: Sprite Tendrils
bases.desc: Microscopic copper-red sprite caps hang over violet branched tendrils: pearl columns, dark root forks and tiny misted termination points.

bases.name: Static Creep
bases.desc: Connected charge creeps around fine crazed enamel islands: doubled metal tracks, frosted insulating ridges, trapped pin sparks and copper junctions.

bases.name: Spark Gap Array
bases.desc: Opposing microscopic silver contacts punctuate burnt-orange ceramic: fractured gap arcs, copper contact shoulders, black ablation pits and fine guard engraving.

bases.name: Jacob's Ladder
bases.desc: Copper rails carry dense ascending arc rungs through jade-black enamel, with white contact shoes, heat-tarnished slots and tiny etched climb marks.

bases.name: Arc Weld Mosaic
bases.desc: Overlapping molten weld dimes in heat-coloured titanium: rolled crescent rims, dark fusion roots, puddle pores and fine flying spatter.

bases.name: Carbon Tracking
bases.desc: Ragged graphite charge ropes creep through pearlescent porcelain: braided char veins, fused glass shoulders, copper contamination and tiny burn-through pores.

bases.name: Fulgurite Glass
bases.desc: Lightning-fused sand becomes an intricate amber tube lace: vitreous walls, dark hollow bores, sintered silica grains, melt striae and trapped pearly bubbles.

bases.name: Erlkonig Swirl
bases.desc: Opposed black-and-ivory camouflage curls splice through fine foil seams, with broken ink bridges, copper register ticks and etched pearl pockets.

bases.name: Confusion Blob
bases.desc: Interlocking amorphous print masks erase panel cues: chalk islands, graphite channels, inner copper keylines and differently coated pigment pockets.

bases.name: Pixel Break Grid
bases.desc: Unequal fine digital rectangles break depth cues through foil planes, black erasure slots, bevelled pixel edges and tiny segmented scan rails.

bases.name: QR Scramble Matrix
bases.desc: Scrambled sensor-style matrices interlock finder assemblies, broken timing rails, foil data modules and matte erased windows across a fine digital skin.

bases.name: Moire Defeat
bases.desc: Contradictory optical domains: two chirped rulings beat across silver print, copper crossings and fine lens seams.

bases.name: Countershade
bases.desc: Backwards shading cancels tiny barrel forms: inverted light belts, dark false crowns, pale underside lips and independently coated registration cuts.

bases.name: False Shadow
bases.desc: Impossible shadow ribbons cross folded print planes: offset cast-shadow wedges, erasure lips, fine hatch pockets and polished witness vertices.

bases.name: Edge Chamfer
bases.desc: Nested impossible bevels divide tiny octagonal plates into silver lips, dark recess claims, copper counter-edges and coated centre windows.

bases.name: Fake Shutline
bases.desc: Contradictory tiny panel gaps cut a false body surface into bevelled jigsaw planes, with offset hinge ticks, stamped seam numbers and coated false shadows.

bases.name: Wireframe Print
bases.desc: A projected impossible truss floats across fine coated facets, with foreshortened cross braces, copper vertex seats, dark mesh voids and clipped dashed occlusion.

bases.name: Decoy Blackout
bases.desc: Fine badge and lamp masks disappear into charcoal: soft blackout fields, gloss witness rims, torn adhesive teeth and hidden coated false-light apertures.

bases.name: Foam Cladding
bases.desc: Fine strapped protective foam has crowded closed-cell cushions, porous compression rims, dark strap roots and small exposed fastening seats.

bases.name: Bubble Cladding
bases.desc: Dense protective air quilts press against translucent cover film, with sealed cells, doubled weld seams, flattened contact crescents and tiny taped witness edges.

bases.name: Gaffer Tape Seam
bases.desc: Crossing fine gaffer strips hold the disguise: torn yarn edges, pressed adhesive lips, folded tape creases, witness fibres and dark overlap counts.

bases.name: Matte Cover Cloth
bases.desc: A deliberately quiet charcoal disguise cloth carries fine crossed yarn, compressed seam lips, dry abrasion sweeps, small pores and uneven tension creases.

bases.name: Retroreflective Patch
bases.desc: Fine glass-bead patches expose pale lens hearts, dark return cups, printed patch seams and minute foil backings beneath a clear binder.

bases.name: Fisheye Lacquer
bases.desc: Candy lacquer draws away from contaminants into irregular craters: exposed metal floors, copper rolled rims and wet menisci over fine metallic pigment.

bases.name: Solvent Pop Lacquer
bases.desc: Ruptured fine solvent blisters tear copper-red lacquer into angular vent mouths, curled shell fragments, dark pinholes and pearled release collars.

bases.name: Sag Curtain Flow
bases.desc: Fine overloaded lacquer runs into branching gravity curtains: bulbous run toes, polished advancing lips, folded wet shoulders and dry separation trenches.

bases.name: Dry Spray Velvet
bases.desc: Half-cured fine droplets form a dense velvet aggregate: granular pigment crowns, unflowed necks, dry island rims, sparse wet binder and tiny trapped pores.

bases.name: Mottled Metallic
bases.desc: Clumped metallic pigment drifts into fine copper-blue islands: differently tilted flake fans, pale binder seams, dark pigment knots and small polished grain tips.

bases.name: Tiger Stripe Spray
bases.desc: Fine gun-pass bands overlap through amber-violet metallic paint, with feathered overspray teeth, polished pass cores, dark overlap seams and individually tilted flakes.

bases.name: Die-Back Patina
bases.desc: Gloss sinks through fine wrinkled lacquer islands: matte collapsed faces, surviving pearl lips, dry crease roots, polished pigment witnesses and subtle coat-density ghosts.

bases.name: Blushed Clearcoat
bases.desc: Moisture whitens rose-violet lacquer into fine milky veils, with binder pockets, condensation stringers, small trapped droplets and surviving polished pigment.

bases.name: Lifted Lacquer
bases.desc: Attacked undercoat buckles into fine peeled ribbons: curled film tongues, exposed primer windows, dark hinge roots, flaked edges and polished swollen shoulders.

bases.name: Sand Scratch Alloy
bases.desc: Fine crossed grit cuts telegraph through blue-bronze alloy paint: scored grooves, raised burr lips, short polishing arcs, grit pores and exposed pigment filings.

bases.name: Dirt Nib Lacquer
bases.desc: Angular dust tents wet lacquer into fine raised peaks, with stretched menisci, dark rooted grit, pearl stress cuts and small trapped binder beads.

bases.name: Repair Edge Map
bases.desc: Fine repaired coating contours reappear as nested gloss witnesses: exposed alloy, primer rings, colour film steps, ghost edge lips and small sanding notches.

bases.name: Rotary Buff Hologram
bases.desc: Tiny rotary arcs overlap through polished cobalt alloy: hooked pigtails, bright arc lips, compound grains, burnished flats and short residual haze bands.

bases.name: Mask Bleed Lace
bases.desc: Fine colour fingers wick beneath cut masks into pale primer: branched capillary tongues, pinned dye beads, sharp mask edges and differently coated bleed menisci.

bases.name: Cured Tape Ridge
bases.desc: Fine cured paint shelves rise around pulled mask cuts: stepped colour plateaus, polished ridge walls, ragged tear teeth, primer slivers and trapped edge pigment.

bases.name: Mineral Water Spot
bases.desc: Drying hard water leaves fine broken mineral rims through lacquer: salt fans, clear lens hearts, etched stain floors and small copper-pearl residue grains.

bases.name: Penetrant Bleed
bases.desc: Branched fatigue fissures with capillary dye reservoirs. Colored inspection artwork with developer wash, wicking halos, open fissures, dye reservoirs, satellite indications.

bases.name: Magnetic Particle
bases.desc: iron powder dragged along the flux leaking out of a crack in a magnetised part

bases.name: Brittle Lacquer
bases.desc: Ranked tensile crack combs with arrested tips and lifted lacquer lips. Colored inspection artwork with lacquer islands, tension cracks, lifted lips, arrest bars, detached flakes.

bases.name: Macro Etch
bases.desc: Bent forging grain ribbons flowing around die bosses. Colored inspection artwork with grain ribbons, etched boundaries, die bosses, compressed bands, inclusion strings.

bases.name: Hardness Indent
bases.desc: Diamond pyramid impressions with four independently polished faces. Colored inspection artwork with indent wells, pyramid faces, pileup rims, corner cracks, traverse dots.

bases.name: Crack Tip Field
bases.desc: Open cracks ending in paired butterfly yield lobes. Colored inspection artwork with crack stems, yield lobes, stress contours, slip fans, arrest tips.

bases.name: Strain Rosette
bases.desc: Three directional serpentine foil gauges with separate solder pads. Colored inspection artwork with polyimide pads, serpentine conductors, return bends, terminal lands, lead wires.

bases.name: Chladni Figure
bases.desc: Intersecting standing wave nodes with granular ridges and scoured antinodes. Colored inspection artwork with modal ridges, node grains, intersection heaps, scoured bellies, stray powder.

bases.name: Isochromatic Fringe
bases.desc: a stressed transparent model in a polariscope, its fringe order read out in spectral colour

bases.name: Isoclinic Band
bases.desc: the dark loci where a principal stress axis lines up with the polariser

bases.name: Holographic Interferogram
bases.desc: Eccentric contour orders surrounding displaced skin blisters. Colored inspection artwork with bulge contours, order shoulders, disbond rims, phase discontinuities, isolated fringe glints.

bases.name: Moire Deflectometry
bases.desc: Two locally displaced ronchi gratings with beat envelopes. Colored inspection artwork with first ruling, crossed ruling, beat knots, deflection seams, registration slits.

bases.name: Shearography
bases.desc: Opposed fringe lobes separated by a displacement derivative null. Colored inspection artwork with positive fringes, negative fringes, null seams, coherent grains, disbond edges.

bases.name: Schlieren
bases.desc: Directional density gradients curling into knife edge flow streaks. Colored inspection artwork with compression ribbons, expansion ribbons, curl cores, shear threads, shock ticks.

bases.name: Shadowgraph
bases.desc: Paired bright and dark shock fronts with refracted crossing wakes. Colored inspection artwork with compression fronts, shadow doubles, shock intersections, wake arcs, fine caustics.

bases.name: Barkhausen Noise
bases.desc: Jagged avalanche domains with pinned walls and burst ladders. Colored inspection artwork with domain plates, jump boundaries, avalanche spikes, pinning inclusions, switching ladders.

bases.name: Eddy Current
bases.desc: the impedance-plane loop a probe's coil traces as it crosses a crack

bases.name: Ultrasonic C-Scan
bases.desc: Raster echo cells quantizing irregular defect islands. Colored inspection artwork with sample cells, echo plateaus, defect margins, dropout pixels, probe steps.

bases.name: A-Scan Gate
bases.desc: Stacked oscilloscope echo trains enclosed by independent gate cursors. Colored inspection artwork with trace baselines, entry pulses, backwall echoes, gate brackets, ringdown ripples.

bases.name: Phased Array
bases.desc: Rotated fan sectors divided into angular beams and curved range gates. Colored inspection artwork with sector wedges, range arcs, hot echo cells, dead beams, focus points.

bases.name: Weld Radiograph
bases.desc: Sinuous multipass weld beads showing internal pores and lack of fusion. Colored inspection artwork with bead ribbons, overlap scallops, gas pores, fusion gaps, dense inclusions.

bases.name: CT Slice
bases.desc: Asymmetric hollow sections with detector ring artifacts and metal streaks. Colored inspection artwork with section walls, internal cavities, detector rings, metal streaks, density islands.

bases.name: Thermoelastic Stress
bases.desc: Opposed thermal stress lobes around loaded perforations sampled on detector pixels. Colored inspection artwork with loaded webs, hot lobes, cool lobes, detector cuts, stress concentration rims.

bases.name: Pulse Thermography
bases.desc: Nested delayed heat islands with independently diffusing perimeters. Colored inspection artwork with warm plateaus, cooling halos, delamination cores, depth contours, sound material channels.

bases.name: Acoustic Emission
bases.desc: Intersecting partial arrival rings and triangulated burst sites. Colored inspection artwork with arrival rings, sensor vertices, triangulation chords, burst stars, attenuation dots.

bases.name: Hex PPF Veil
bases.desc: Fine engineered polymer cells partition elastic protective film: recovered roofs, narrow adhesive seats, short stress ribs, healing witnesses and small pigment traces.

bases.name: Twill Surge Foil
bases.desc: Fine curved unequal warp/weft ribbons obey two-over-one twill occlusion, with underpasses, pressed crowns, parallel edge filaments and split ends.

bases.name: Truchet Facet Knurl
bases.desc: Binary diagonal folds join opposed triangular foil facets into an irregular knurl network; fine engraved grip cuts, blind adhesive windows, clinched corner bosses and keyed fold tabs belong to their own facet.

bases.name: Craze Fracture Lacquer
bases.desc: Fine unequal angular brittle fissures branch through film, with stopped tips, asymmetrically lifted lips, rooted secondary cracks and flaked junctions.

bases.name: Lenticular Lens Field
bases.desc: Unequal fine short cylindrical lenticules stagger in direction and carry paired opposing print lanes, barrel crowns, recessed roots and polished cap ends.

bases.name: Flow Streamlet Inlay
bases.desc: Dense short curving foil streamlets follow a rotating grain field; independently crowned ribbons split into twin tails over recessed ink beds, with one polished rail, transverse braking cuts, leading prism lips and blind tension ports. No continuous lamella or broad common background carries the design.

bases.name: Spiral Burnish Film
bases.desc: Dense fine eccentric spiral polish scores connect through short dragged tails in a continuous clear film, with score lips, compound grains and unbroken smooth recovery lands.

bases.name: Overlap Ghost Register
bases.desc: Two independent fine angular film-island fields overlap, showing doubled buried silhouettes, paired menisci, clipped lower print edges and trapped adhesive pockets.

bases.name: Panel Step Inlay
bases.desc: Irregular fine trapezoidal film panels meet through offset stair joints, exposed adhesive lands and tiny keyed corners.

bases.name: Squeegee Witness
bases.desc: Unequal dense fine diagonal installer passes overlap at changing angles; rolled pressure toes, dragged adhesive ribs, dark rear roots and recovering shoulders belong to each actual pass.

bases.name: Knife Cut Suture
bases.desc: A fine nonperiodic angular cut network has displaced one-sided flaps, exposed backing, interrupted uncut bridges and pointed turn burrs.

bases.name: Layered Cut Foil
bases.desc: Two independent laser-cut foil webs interpenetrate: openings reveal the lower sheet, deep backing, adhesive undercuts and polished cut rims.

bases.name: Lifted Film Edges
bases.desc: Unequal fine polygonal shingles lift at selected boundaries, exposing curled undersides, amber adhesive lands, dark hinges and directional roof creases.

bases.name: Microbubble Emboss
bases.desc: Asymmetric fine four-lobed trapped-air pillows join through continuous sealing webs, with pinch roots and tiny satellite vents.

bases.name: Crease Fold Prism
bases.desc: Unequal fine triangular fan folds have alternating front/back planes, short discontinuous hinges, crumpled junctions and sharp crease roots.

bases.name: Heat Glazed Print
bases.desc: Fine displaced halftone inks soften inside unequal thermal dwell patches; glazed film, stretched recovery streaks, melted pigment pools and rooted witness lips trace the heated print.

bases.name: Wet Apply Meniscus
bases.desc: Unequal fine elongated liquid lenses connect by capillary drainage paths; dry contact islands, pale menisci and particle wakes show liquid under film.

bases.name: Air Release Manifold
bases.desc: Fine curving adhesive spines feed staggered oblique blind vents; unequal collector pockets, narrowed throats, paired channel walls and film roof ribs trace manufactured air routing without box-grid intersections.

bases.name: Perforated Window Film
bases.desc: Fine short rounded oblique slots have staggered lengths and alternating punch angles; thin web bridges, recessed backing and asymmetric burrs establish actual perforation.

bases.name: Laminate Parallax
bases.desc: Two independently engraved fine plies have offset angular windows, separate projected rulings, double cut edges and adhesive moire.

bases.name: Print Register Prism
bases.desc: Unequal fine oblique print-pass bars carry three displaced ink registrations, dark overlap traps, clipped halftone dots and small foil slots.

bases.name: Brushed Satin Alloy
bases.desc: Unequal directed bundles contain five to nine short 8–28px brush filaments with tapered starts, broken ends, crossgrain cuts and displaced burrs.

bases.name: Holographic Foil
bases.desc: Security foil filled with microscopic engraved rosettes, ruled diffraction sectors, pale register cores and gold ghost rings.

bases.name: Roll Memory Scroll
bases.desc: Opposing incomplete fine spiral turns alternate handedness and unequal pitch, with open seams, compressed ribs and thin turning lips.

bases.name: Ceramic Levelled Glaze
bases.desc: Intact continuous blue-grey glaze carries fine unequal levelling tongues, short fluid contact necks, attached glass beads, cured menisci, local wipe striae and rare pigment witnesses. Small fluid anatomy owns the image; quiet paint is intentional.

bases.name: Disco: Boogie Neon

bases.name: Disco: Discotheque Haze
bases.desc: Dry ice and cigarette smoke holding the beams up where you can see them.

bases.name: Disco: Glitter Ball Rain
bases.desc: The dots the ball throws, moving across everything in the room at once.

bases.name: Disco: Hustle Teal
bases.desc: Polyester in a colour that only existed for about six years.

bases.name: Disco: Lighted Floor

bases.name: Disco: Lurex Gold

bases.name: Disco: Lurex Rose
bases.desc: The same thread in rose gold, on a body-con knit that has no give in it at all.

bases.name: Disco: Mirror Ball

bases.name: Disco: Platform Patent

bases.name: Disco: Roller Rink

bases.name: Disco: Saturday Chrome

bases.name: Disco: Sequin Sheet
bases.desc: Overlapping paillettes stitched in courses, every one free to flip.

bases.name: Disco: Studio Gold
bases.desc: Gilt, mirror and a doorman. The room was mostly dark and entirely gold.

bases.name: Disco: Velvet Rope

bases.name: Disco: Vinyl Groove
bases.desc: A twelve-inch single, lit from the side so the groove pitch shows.

bases.name: Shag: Conversation Pit

bases.name: Shag: Corduroy Brown

bases.name: Shag: Fondue Copper

bases.name: Shag: Formica Boomerang
bases.desc: Laminate with the little shapes on it, and a chrome edge strip.

bases.name: Shag: Lava Lamp
bases.desc: Wax rising in a column, never quite the same shape twice.

bases.name: Shag: Linoleum Teal

bases.name: Shag: Macramé Hang

bases.name: Shag: Popcorn Ceiling
bases.desc: Sprayed texture with a little sparkle in it, and asbestos, probably.

bases.name: Shag: Rattan Weave
bases.desc: A peacock chair nobody could actually sit in comfortably.

bases.name: Shag: Shag Avocado
bases.desc: Two inches of pile in a colour named after a fruit, and a rake to comb it.

bases.name: Shag: Shag Harvest

bases.name: Shag: Smoked Glass

bases.name: Shag: Tab Curtain

bases.name: Shag: Terrazzo Kitchen

bases.name: Shag: Wood Panel

bases.name: Outlaw: Barbed Wire

bases.name: Outlaw: Basket Stamp

bases.name: Outlaw: Concho Row

bases.name: Outlaw: Longhorn Hide

bases.name: Outlaw: Mesa Sunset

bases.name: Outlaw: Outlaw Chrome

bases.name: Outlaw: Prairie Denim
bases.desc: Chambray gone pale at the shoulders from a decade of sun.

bases.name: Outlaw: Raw Denim

bases.name: Outlaw: Rhinestone Suit
bases.desc: A Nudie suit: chain stitch, cactus, and more stones than the wearer could afford.

bases.name: Outlaw: Rodeo Dust

bases.name: Outlaw: Silver Buckle

bases.name: Outlaw: Snakeskin Boot
bases.desc: Belly cut, lacquered, on a boot that cost more than the horse.

bases.name: Outlaw: Tooled Saddle

bases.name: Outlaw: Turquoise Silver
bases.desc: Sleeping Beauty stone in a hand-stamped bezel, with the matrix showing.

bases.name: Van: Candy Apple

bases.name: Van: Desert Scene

bases.name: Van: Eagle Gold

bases.name: Van: Flame Job

bases.name: Van: Ghost Mural

bases.name: Van: Metalflake Blue

bases.name: Van: Metalflake Red

bases.name: Van: Pinstripe Kit

bases.desc: Chrome silver + sapphire + ruby + emerald. Four crown jewels on one car.

bases.name: CX Apocalypse
bases.desc: Scorching white + blood red + rust orange + dead black. The end of everything.

bases.name: MS Acid Veil Ambush
bases.desc: Acid mist veil hiding chrome strike zones. Toxic ambush vibe.

bases.name: MS Blood Empress
bases.desc: Regal deep-crimson with imperial gold edge highlights. Empress aura.

bases.name: MS Bone Sonata
bases.desc: Bone-white plate with melodic shadow ribs. Skeletal harmony.

bases.name: MS Chainburst Inferno
bases.desc: Cascading flame chains burst across dark metal. Chain reaction inferno.

bases.name: MS Cinder Spiral
bases.desc: Spiraling ember sparks on cooling ash substrate. Cinder vortex.

bases.name: MS Crimson Dragon
bases.desc: Dragon-scale crimson with shadow-etched scale boundaries. Apex predator.

bases.name: MS Cryo Shard
bases.desc: Frozen cyan shards on glacial substrate. Sub-zero kill strike.

bases.name: MS Crystal Onslaught
bases.desc: Faceted crystal assault with prism-edge refraction. Shatter-strike.

bases.name: MS Dragon Ascent
bases.desc: Ascending dragon gold with flame-trail accents. Rising power finish.

bases.name: MS Dragon Soul
bases.desc: Soul-ember dragon jade with inner glow channels. Spiritual depth.

bases.name: MS Emerald Scale Mirage
bases.desc: Emerald scale shimmer that shifts at viewing angle. Iridescent mirage.

bases.name: MS Fang Cataclysm
bases.desc: Tooth-shard cataclysm on slate armor. Predator devastation.

bases.name: MS Frost Sentinel
bases.desc: Frozen sentinel-blue with vigilant ice crystals. Guardian frost.

bases.name: MS Frozen Inferno
bases.desc: Paradox blue cold-flame on icefire substrate. Frozen burn.

bases.name: MS Lotus Ascention
bases.desc: Sacred lotus rising in pink-gold petals. Spiritual ascent finish.

bases.name: MS Molten Sting
bases.desc: Molten metal sting with droplet flares. Liquid-flame venom.

bases.name: MS Porcelain Cipher
bases.desc: Encoded porcelain glaze with cipher-line crackles. Mystery finish.

bases.name: MS Serpent Haze Strike
bases.desc: Toxic serpent haze with venom-strike accents. Coiled deadliness.

bases.name: MS Shadow Wraith
bases.desc: Spectral wraith-black with faint shadow-duplicate shimmer. Nearly invisible.

bases.name: MS Soul Forge
bases.desc: Forged amber with soul-ember inner glow. Crafted-spirit finish.

bases.name: MS Tempest Crown
bases.desc: Storm-crown tempest blue with lightning crown veins. Sovereign storm.

bases.name: MS Thunder Mandala
bases.desc: Sacred thunder mandala in electric violet rays. Storm-spiritual finish.

bases.name: MS Toxic Labyrinth
bases.desc: Toxic neon maze on contaminated substrate. Hazmat puzzle aesthetic.

bases.name: MS Venom Eclipse
bases.desc: Eclipse venom-dark purple with corona shimmer. Total venom blackout.

bases.name: MS Venom Veil
bases.desc: Venomous veil mixing serpent green and amethyst poison.

bases.name: MS Zero Hour
bases.desc: Final-hour steel grey with last-second crisis veins. Apocalypse finish.

bases.name: MSH: Canary Coffin
bases.desc: V2 — electric blue body, lavender/pink coffin-rust reveal; finer spec gates + chroma lift.

bases.name: MSH: Magenta Widow
bases.desc: V2 — deep blue-indigo body, hot pink/crimson web flashes. Neon ice base + widow venom overlay.

bases.name: MSH: Cerulean Cobra
bases.desc: V2 — sapphire-indigo body, molten gold scale bloom. Deep blue hue rotation, no white wash.

bases.name: MSH: Lime Scorpion
bases.desc: Violet-indigo base with ember-hex copper bloom. Densest spec tiling in the set.

bases.name: MSH: Hyperpink Torii
bases.desc: V2 — sapphire-teal body, peach-gold torii lattice flare. Magenta arc → deep blue, colored reveal.

bases.name: MSH: Seafoam Piranha
bases.desc: V2 — deep blue body, electric aqua/magenta current streaks. Cerulean base replaces dead seafoam green.

bases.name: MSH: Orchid Kintsugi
bases.desc: Teal-green body, champagne-gold crack-line reveal. Orchid pulse + kintsugi rift.

bases.name: MSH: Peach Jellyshock
bases.desc: V2 — ice-blue body, burned hot pink jelly drift. Owner hue-shift proof: blue base + jellyshock overlay.

bases.name: MSH: Daffodil Bayou
bases.desc: V2 — electric indigo body, violet/pink bayou script smoke. Canary→indigo + denser bayou overlay.

bases.name: MSH: Neon Ice Rising
bases.desc: Ice-blue body, sunset orange prismwave crown on roof and quarters.

bases.name: MSHC: Tigerblood Voltage
bases.desc: Deep indigo body, amber tiger-claw flash on glancing sun. Tiger Fang Fracture overlay.

bases.name: MSHC: Oxblood Seigaiha
bases.desc: Magenta → sea-green wave body with chrome crest peaks. Seigaiha Chrome overlay.

bases.name: MSHC: Emerald Sharkbite
bases.desc: Seafoam → ruby-coral reveal with salt-teeth gates. Sharkbite Riptide overlay.

bases.name: MSHC: Amber Panther
bases.desc: Peach → deep teal-night body, amber pearl glints catch on curve. Panther Shadow Claw overlay.

bases.name: MSHC: Violet Kyoto
bases.desc: Cerulean → red-violet with gold filigree pins. Kyoto Lantern Filigree overlay.

bases.name: MSHC: Acid Hornet
bases.desc: Pink → acid yellow-green swarm reveal. Hornet Swarm Static overlay.

bases.name: MSHC: Oni Orchid Glass
bases.desc: Orchid → coral-amber demon-mosaic shadows. Oni Veil Mosaic overlay.

bases.name: MSHC: Copper Jubilee
bases.desc: Daffodil → indigo-blue with warm copper voodoo-root reveal. Root Doctor Copper overlay.

bases.name: MSHC: Canary Widow Redux
bases.desc: Canary → coral-orange with ruby web flashes. Same base, +63 rotation, Widow Web Venom.

bases.name: MSHC: Rosethorn Bonsai
bases.desc: Ice blue → soft violet-rose with leaf-circuit gates. Bonsai Drift Circuit overlay.

bases.name: MSHA: Canary Gris-Gris
bases.desc: Electric indigo-blue base with a soft pearlescent amethyst crystal shift. Midnight Gris-Gris overlay.

bases.name: MSHA: Emerald Brocade
bases.desc: Bright jade-teal body that flashes coral-gold scales in direct sunlight. Shogun Scale Brocade overlay.

bases.name: MSHA: Fuji Neon Crest
bases.desc: Icy cyan-violet base that blooms with warm bronze-pink frost peaks. Fuji Frost Crest overlay.

bases.name: MSHA: Volcanic Croc
bases.desc: Deep indigo body shifting to molten lava gold plates under high angles. Croc Delta Armor overlay.

bases.name: MSHA: Cherry Blossom Flux
bases.desc: Intense sky-teal body blooming cherry-blossom pink under direct solar rays. Sakura Static overlay.

bases.name: MSHA: Waxen Voodoo
bases.desc: Cobalt-violet body with shifting pale amber candle-wax veves catching solar glare. Candle Wax Veve overlay.

bases.name: MSHA: Hyperpink Threads
bases.desc: Neon violet base with golden micro-thread grid reveals that sparkle under motion. Pins & Thread overlay.

bases.name: MSHA: Peach Burlap
bases.desc: Mint-teal base with shifting copper-rose hex burlap texture. Bayou Hex Burlap overlay.

bases.name: MSHA: Seafoam Charm
bases.desc: Royal purple body with shifting emerald-patina charms under grazing sunlight. Swamp Charm Patina overlay.

bases.name: MSHA: Solar Moss
bases.desc: Electric magenta base that shifts to moss-green sparkles under glanced lighting. Spanish Moss Static overlay.

bases.name: MSHX: Blueprint Jackpot V2
bases.desc: Rebuilt after owner 3/REBUILD — tighter coffin gates, stronger blue-indigo landing, brighter lavender/pink flare.

bases.name: MSHX: Venom Cashmere V2
bases.desc: Rebuilt after owner 4/REBUILD — neon-ice base, blue/purple body, colored tiger-fang glints instead of white glare.

bases.name: MSHX: Glacier Pinkslip V2
bases.desc: Rebuilt after owner 3/REBUILD — Prism Tipjar-derived sapphire body with sharkbite pink/ice flare.

bases.name: MSHX: Lime Afterburner V2
bases.desc: Rebuilt after owner 5/REBUILD — deeper blue-purple landing with dense copper scorpion ember cells.

bases.name: MSHX: Miami Blacklight V2
bases.desc: Rebuilt after owner 3/REBUILD — neon-ice substrate with magenta widow-web flare baked into the reveal.

bases.name: MSHX: Royal Sunstroke V2
bases.desc: Rebuilt after owner 3/REBUILD — canary-to-indigo base with champagne/pink Kyoto pin bloom.

bases.name: MSHX: Kintsugi Ransom
bases.desc: Teal-night paint with pale-gold fracture flashes that read expensive fast. Orchid + Kintsugi Rift.

bases.name: MSHX: Coral Sharkskin V2
bases.desc: Rebuilt after owner 3/REBUILD — owner-proven blue-base direction with hot piranha current scratches.

bases.name: MSHX: Dover Jackpot V2
bases.desc: Rebuilt after owner 3/REBUILD — darker indigo Dover body with tighter violet/pink smoke-script payout.

bases.name: MSHX: Prism Tipjar
bases.desc: Sapphire-teal body tipping warm orange/pink from prismwave micro-crowns in motion. Magenta + Rising Sun Prismwave.

bases.name: Import Royalty
bases.desc: Layered razor vinyl slashes with prismatic tuner-wrap edges.

bases.name: Toxic Overdrive
bases.desc: Acid-green current pools with yellow pressure lips and black sink regions.

bases.name: Neon Underglow
bases.desc: Ground-effects cyan and magenta rising through smoked wet-look paint.

bases.name: Blacklight Garage
bases.desc: Fluorescent solvent pools and ultraviolet shop-light reflections on concrete black.

bases.name: Burnout Ember
bases.desc: Curved tire-heat tracks, underlit smoke and ember-red rubber fragments.

bases.name: Redline Rush
bases.desc: Escalating redline heat and speed rhythm without a literal gauge.

bases.name: Tunnel Vision
bases.desc: Vanishing tunnel lights stretching into yellow, cyan and white speed wedges.

bases.name: Nitro Purge
bases.desc: Electric-blue purge plumes, frost shock and white pressure cores.

bases.name: Split Underglow
bases.desc: Opposed cyan and magenta ground-light fields dividing a smoked body.

bases.name: Afterburn Chrome
bases.desc: Heat-shifted chrome with broad spectral oxidation bands and brushed fire.

monolithics.name: Vellum Leaf
monolithics.desc: Calfskin scraped, limed and stretched, still showing the follicle side.

monolithics.name: Iron Gall Ink
monolithics.desc: Oak gall and green vitriol — black going brown, and eating the page slowly.

monolithics.name: Gilt Edge
monolithics.desc: Leaf laid on the block edge and burnished, so the closed book is solid gold.

monolithics.name: Ribbon Marker
monolithics.desc: Woven silk bound into the spine, frayed at the end from a century of use.

monolithics.name: Foxed Page
monolithics.desc: Rust-coloured spots blooming through the paper wherever the damp got in.

monolithics.name: Woodcut Block
monolithics.desc: Cut against the end grain so the line can be as fine as the printer dares.

monolithics.name: Illuminated Capital
monolithics.desc: One letter given a week, gold over gesso, with a hare in the descender.

monolithics.name: Marbled Endpaper
monolithics.desc: Colour floated on size and combed, then lifted in one pull. No two ever match.

monolithics.name: Calf Binding
monolithics.desc: Full calf, blind-tooled, darkened at the joints where the hands go.

monolithics.name: Wax Seal
monolithics.desc: Poured, stamped, and cracked across the middle the moment it was opened.

monolithics.name: Glass Slipper
monolithics.desc: It fits one person and it is made of glass — both facts are the whole story.

monolithics.name: Spindle Gold
monolithics.desc: Straw in at night and gold on the bobbin by morning, at a price agreed too fast.

monolithics.name: Crown Jewel
monolithics.desc: Cut to throw light rather than to keep weight, which is a choice about being seen.

monolithics.name: Mirror Mirror
monolithics.desc: It only ever answers the question it was asked, which is the trouble with it.

monolithics.name: Poisoned Apple
monolithics.desc: One side red enough to sell it, and the seller ate the other half first.

monolithics.name: Royal Velvet
monolithics.desc: Cut pile deep enough to hold a handprint, in the purple nobody else was allowed.

monolithics.name: Seven-League Boot
monolithics.desc: Twenty-one miles a stride, and creased across the instep like any other boot.

monolithics.name: Tower Stone
monolithics.desc: Coursed rubble with one window, set higher than anybody sensible would build.

monolithics.name: Briar Hedge
monolithics.desc: A hundred years of growth in one night, and every thorn pointing outward.

monolithics.name: Pumpkin Coach
monolithics.desc: Ribbed, gilded, and on a strict schedule.

monolithics.name: Wolf Pelt
monolithics.desc: Guard hairs over a dense undercoat, banded so the grey is never one grey.

monolithics.name: Breadcrumb Trail
monolithics.desc: A plan that depended on the birds not being hungry.

monolithics.name: Gingerbread
monolithics.desc: Baked hard, iced at the seams, and structurally sounder than it looks.

monolithics.name: Red Hood
monolithics.desc: Wool, hooded, and the single most visible thing in a winter wood.

monolithics.name: Thorn Thicket
monolithics.desc: Blackthorn: the spines are modified branches, which is why they are that hard.

monolithics.name: Moss Stone
monolithics.desc: North face, always. It is the only compass in the story that works.

monolithics.name: Lantern Path
monolithics.desc: Lit one at a time, ahead of you, by somebody who left before you arrived.

monolithics.name: Owl Feather
monolithics.desc: A serrated leading edge that breaks the air up so nothing downstairs hears it.

monolithics.name: Fox Fur
monolithics.desc: Red over cream over black, in that order, on every single hair.

monolithics.name: Beanstalk
monolithics.desc: Twining left to right because that is what beans do, all the way up.

monolithics.name: Dragon Scale
monolithics.desc: Overlapping, keeled, and each one anchored deeper than it looks.

monolithics.name: Hoard Gold
monolithics.desc: Counted once, a very long time ago, and every coin missed since.

monolithics.name: Phoenix Ash
monolithics.desc: The interesting part is not the fire. It is what is still warm underneath.

monolithics.name: Griffin Bronze
monolithics.desc: Cast in two halves and pinned, with the join green where the rain sits.

monolithics.name: Unicorn Horn
monolithics.desc: A single spiral groove, always the same handedness, in something that is not ivory.

monolithics.name: Mermaid Scale
monolithics.desc: Guanine platelets stacked to a quarter wavelength, which is why they are that colour.

monolithics.name: Basilisk Stone
monolithics.desc: Whatever it looked at last is still standing there, in considerable detail.

monolithics.name: Kraken Ink
monolithics.desc: Released as a decoy shaped roughly like the animal that released it.

monolithics.name: Faerie Wing
monolithics.desc: Structural colour in a membrane two cells thick. No pigment involved at all.

monolithics.name: Troll Granite
monolithics.desc: Caught out by the sunrise, and now part of the landscape.

monolithics.name: Cauldron Brew
monolithics.desc: Double, double. It has been on since Tuesday and nobody remembers the recipe.

monolithics.name: Spellbook Vellum
monolithics.desc: Written in a hand that expected to be read aloud, and once only.

monolithics.name: Wishing Well
monolithics.desc: Nine metres of cold water and about forty years of small change.

monolithics.name: Moon Path
monolithics.desc: It points at you from wherever you stand, which is either lovely or a warning.

monolithics.name: Star Dust
monolithics.desc: Everything heavier than helium, and all of it secondhand.

monolithics.name: Enchanted Ice
monolithics.desc: It does not melt, which is the tell. Real ice is always in a hurry.

monolithics.name: Witch Amber
monolithics.desc: Something small is in it, and it has been looking out for a very long time.

monolithics.name: Rune Stone
monolithics.desc: Straight lines only — carved across the grain, by people who carved into wood first.

monolithics.name: Potion Glass
monolithics.desc: Hand-blown, unevenly walled, and stoppered with something chewed.

monolithics.name: Genie Brass
monolithics.desc: Polished on one side from rubbing, and considerably larger on the inside.

monolithics.name: Wet Asphalt
monolithics.desc: Road after rain, holding every light in the street in a thin film.

monolithics.name: Oil Slick
monolithics.desc: A film one wavelength thick on black water, and every colour in it.

monolithics.name: Manhole Steam
monolithics.desc: Vapour off a grate at 3am, lit from one side and gone by morning.

monolithics.name: Tyre Black
monolithics.desc: Moulded tread in the deadest black there is, with the mould line still on it.

monolithics.name: Tar Seam
monolithics.desc: Poured hot into the joint, gone hard and glossy where it pooled.

monolithics.name: Gutter Chrome
monolithics.desc: Water finding the low line, and the low line turning out to be polished.

monolithics.name: Night Rain
monolithics.desc: Vertical water against a dark building, each drop its own lens.

monolithics.name: Kerb Grit
monolithics.desc: Swept into the edge and left there — the chalkiest dark on the shelf.

monolithics.name: Storm Drain
monolithics.desc: Routed underneath everything, and the only light is what falls in.

monolithics.name: Blacktop Heat
monolithics.desc: Fresh laid and still soft, shimmering where the sun is still on it.

monolithics.name: Obsidian Chill
monolithics.desc: Cooled too fast to crystallise. Conchoidal, and sharper than surgical steel.

monolithics.name: Basalt Glass
monolithics.desc: Columns cracked by their own cooling, with a glassy skin on every face.

monolithics.name: Hematite
monolithics.desc: Iron oxide polished until it turns into a mirror that is somehow still red.

monolithics.name: Tourmaline Black
monolithics.desc: Schorl: black until you turn it, and then it is not black at all.

monolithics.name: Onyx Band
monolithics.desc: Banded chalcedony cut across the layers so the bands read as stripes.

monolithics.name: Magnetite
monolithics.desc: Lodestone in a field, standing up into spikes because it can.

monolithics.name: Jet Carve
monolithics.desc: Fossil wood cut and polished for mourning jewellery, warm to the touch.

monolithics.name: Shungite
monolithics.desc: Carbon that predates multicellular life, and conducts like it knows it.

monolithics.name: Anthracite
monolithics.desc: Hard coal with a vitreous fracture — the cleanest burn and the brightest break.

monolithics.name: Galena Cube
monolithics.desc: Lead sulphide cleaving into perfect cubes, each face a small dull mirror.

monolithics.name: Abyss Blue
monolithics.desc: Below the last light. Whatever is down there makes its own.

monolithics.name: Midnight Teal
monolithics.desc: A pool lit from under the water, at the hour the party thins out.

monolithics.name: Ink Well
monolithics.desc: Iron gall ink pooling in the bottom of the well, thick enough to stand a nib in.

monolithics.name: Prussian
monolithics.desc: The first modern synthetic blue, and still the deepest one in the box.

monolithics.name: Deep Pine
monolithics.desc: Closed canopy at dusk, where the green has gone almost to black.

monolithics.name: Bottle Green
monolithics.desc: Thick cast glass — black on edge, green through the face, and full of bubbles.

monolithics.name: Nocturne
monolithics.desc: Written to be played quietly, in a room with one lamp on.

monolithics.name: Cobalt Night
monolithics.desc: Cobalt on a dark body, fired so the pigment sinks into the glaze.

monolithics.name: Viridian Dark
monolithics.desc: Hydrated chromium oxide: a green so deep it argues with black.

monolithics.name: Indigo Vault
monolithics.desc: Twelve dips and a day in the air between each, until it stops being blue.

monolithics.name: Oxblood
monolithics.desc: Boot polish built up over years, worn back at the toe to something darker.

monolithics.name: Garnet Dark
monolithics.desc: Almandine: opaque in the hand and full of fire the moment it is lit.

monolithics.name: Ember Gold
monolithics.desc: A bed with no flame left on it, and more heat than it looks like.

monolithics.name: Burgundy
monolithics.desc: In the bottle it is black; against a candle it is not.

monolithics.name: Dried Rose
monolithics.desc: Kept in a book for a decade, gone to paper and holding the colour anyway.

monolithics.name: Brass Night
monolithics.desc: Unlacquered and left alone, so it darkens everywhere a hand does not go.

monolithics.name: Molten Seam
monolithics.desc: Cold plate with something still liquid running in the joint.

monolithics.name: Copper Dark
monolithics.desc: Roofing copper eight winters in, before the green arrives and after the shine goes.

monolithics.name: Rust Noir
monolithics.desc: Oxide advancing across a dark panel, and winning, slowly.

monolithics.name: Amber Vault
monolithics.desc: Resin with something in it, forty million years into a very slow set.

monolithics.name: Arc Weld
monolithics.desc: Strike an arc without a helmet once and you remember it for a week.

monolithics.name: Lightning Black
monolithics.desc: One channel out of a thousand attempts, and it lasts thirty microseconds.

monolithics.name: Filament
monolithics.desc: Coiled tungsten at 2800K, which is most of the way to giving up.

monolithics.name: Neon Scar
monolithics.desc: Bent glass on a black wall, and the wall is only there to hold it.

monolithics.name: Laser Cut
monolithics.desc: A kerf a quarter of a millimetre wide, with the heat colour still on the edge.

monolithics.name: Plasma Seam
monolithics.desc: Where the ionised column touches metal, and the metal notices.

monolithics.name: Spark Trail
monolithics.desc: Grinding wheel on mild steel: each spark a burning particle with a lifetime.

monolithics.name: Hot Wire
monolithics.desc: Nichrome through foam, glowing exactly as much as the current says.

monolithics.name: Tracer
monolithics.desc: Every fifth round burning, which is how you learn where the others went.

monolithics.name: Flashover
monolithics.desc: Every surface in the room reaching ignition temperature at the same moment.

monolithics.name: Ireland: Aran Cable
monolithics.desc: Honeycomb and cable worked in undyed bainin wool, every stitch countable.

monolithics.name: Ireland: Burren Pavement
monolithics.desc: Limestone pavement scored into clints and grykes by rain that took its time.

monolithics.name: Ireland: Connemara Marble
monolithics.desc: Serpentine marble from the west — green banding folded by four hundred million years.

monolithics.name: Ireland: Peat Cut
monolithics.desc: A turf bank sliced open — ten thousand years of bog laid down in readable courses.

monolithics.name: Ireland: Stout Head
monolithics.desc: Nitrogen cascade settling into a cream head over black. The surge is the whole point.

monolithics.name: Norway: Arctic Light
monolithics.desc: Two hours of blue dusk that never becomes day, in the week either side of solstice.

monolithics.name: Norway: Birch Bark
monolithics.desc: Paper birch peeling in horizontal ribbons, each lenticel a dark dash across the white.

monolithics.name: Norway: Fjord Water
monolithics.desc: Meltwater over a drowned glacial valley, cold enough to change the colour of the light.

monolithics.name: Norway: Rosemaling
monolithics.desc: Rose painting on a dowry chest — C-scrolls and cross-hatched flowers, freehand, no pencil.

monolithics.name: Norway: Slate Roof
monolithics.desc: Riven slate hung in courses, thick at the eave and thin at the ridge, good for four hundred years.

monolithics.name: Portugal: Azulejo Blue
monolithics.desc: Cobalt on tin glaze, tile after tile up a whole façade, crazed by two centuries of weather.

monolithics.name: Portugal: Calçada Wave
monolithics.desc: Black and white limestone cubes set by hand into a rolling wave, a pavement you notice.

monolithics.name: Portugal: Cork Bark
monolithics.desc: Stripped every nine years and it grows back. Nothing else on earth does this.

monolithics.name: Portugal: Douro Schist
monolithics.desc: Terraces cut into schist so the vines can find water. The rock is the terroir.

monolithics.name: Portugal: Sardine Tin
monolithics.desc: Packed nose to tail in oil, under a lithographed lid brighter than the fish.

monolithics.name: Scotland: Cairngorm Granite
monolithics.desc: Coarse pink granite with smoky quartz in it, every crystal a different mind.

monolithics.name: Scotland: Cask Char
monolithics.desc: Level four char on American oak. The alligator skin inside is what makes the whisky.

monolithics.name: Scotland: Harris Tweed
monolithics.desc: Handwoven in the Outer Hebrides from dyed-in-the-wool yarn, so the colour is IN the fibre.

monolithics.name: Scotland: Heather Moor
monolithics.desc: Ling in full flower over peat — purple to the horizon and knee-deep in it.

monolithics.name: Scotland: Tartan Sett
monolithics.desc: One sequence of threads, reflected about its pivots and run both ways. Order you can wear.

monolithics.name: India: Block Print
monolithics.desc: Hand-cut teak blocks, one per colour, walked across the cloth by eye and never quite in register.

monolithics.name: India: Madras Check
monolithics.desc: Handloom cotton in vegetable dye, made to bleed — the fading is a feature you pay for.

monolithics.name: India: Marigold Mound
monolithics.desc: Genda strung by the kilometre and heaped at the flower market, orange past the point of sense.

monolithics.name: India: Mirror Work
monolithics.desc: Shisha discs caught under a ring of chain stitch, so a whole skirt throws light back at you.

monolithics.name: India: Sandstone Jali
monolithics.desc: A screen carved from one slab, cutting the sun into geometry and letting the wind through.

monolithics.name: Japan: Aizome Vat
monolithics.desc: Fermented indigo. The cloth comes out green and turns blue in the air while you watch.

monolithics.name: Japan: Kintsugi Seam
monolithics.desc: The break repaired in gold rather than hidden, so the history is the most valuable part.

monolithics.name: Japan: Raku Crackle
monolithics.desc: Pulled from the kiln red hot and thrown into sawdust. The crazing is the record of the shock.

monolithics.name: Japan: Urushi Lacquer
monolithics.desc: Forty coats of tree sap, each cured in a damp box and polished back with charcoal.

monolithics.name: Japan: Washi Fibre
monolithics.desc: Kozo bark beaten and floated — long fibres locked into a sheet strong enough to be a wall.

monolithics.name: Korea: Bojagi Patch
monolithics.desc: Wrapping cloth pieced from offcuts, seams flat-felled so it reads from either side.

monolithics.name: Korea: Celadon Glaze
monolithics.desc: Goryeo green — iron reduced in a starved kiln until it goes the colour of shallow water.

monolithics.name: Korea: Dancheong
monolithics.desc: Mineral pigment on temple timber — it is decoration, and it is also what stops the wood rotting.

monolithics.name: Korea: Hanji Sheet
monolithics.desc: Mulberry paper couched a hundred times. Strong enough to floor a room and be walked on.

monolithics.name: Korea: Najeon Inlay
monolithics.desc: Abalone cut into hairlines and laid into black lacquer, so the light moves when you do.

monolithics.name: Türkiye: Hammered Copper
monolithics.desc: Planished by hand in the coppersmiths' bazaar, every facet a hammer blow you can count.

monolithics.name: Türkiye: Iznik Tile
monolithics.desc: Quartz-bodied tile under a clear glaze — cobalt, turquoise, and the red that took a century to get.

monolithics.name: Türkiye: Kilim Weave
monolithics.desc: Slit-woven flatweave — no pile, so the pattern is the structure and it reads both sides.

monolithics.name: Türkiye: Meerschaum
monolithics.desc: Sepiolite carved wet and soft, then smoked for thirty years until it goes amber from the inside.

monolithics.name: Türkiye: Nazar Glass
monolithics.desc: Cobalt glass rings, wound hot on the rod and hung anywhere luck is needed.

monolithics.name: Egypt: Alabaster
monolithics.desc: Calcite banded by dripping water, cut thin enough that a lamp inside shows through the wall.

monolithics.name: Egypt: Desert Glass
monolithics.desc: Libyan silica glass — sand fused by something that came out of the sky 29 million years ago.

monolithics.name: Egypt: Faience Blue
monolithics.desc: Not clay at all — ground quartz that brings its own glaze to the surface as it dries.

monolithics.name: Egypt: Lapis Ground
monolithics.desc: Lazurite with pyrite through it, carried two thousand miles from Badakhshan to be ground up.

monolithics.name: Egypt: Papyrus Weave
monolithics.desc: Pith sliced, laid at right angles and beaten until its own sap glues it into a sheet.

monolithics.name: Ethiopia: Basalt Highland
monolithics.desc: Flood basalt stacked three kilometres deep, then split open by the rift underneath it.

monolithics.name: Ethiopia: Coffee Bed
monolithics.desc: Cherries drying on raised beds, raked by hand every hour so the ferment stays even.

monolithics.name: Ethiopia: Danakil Salt
monolithics.desc: Salt pans a hundred metres below the sea, cut into slabs and carried out by camel.

monolithics.name: Ethiopia: Lalibela Stone
monolithics.desc: Churches cut DOWN into the rock, roof first, out of one piece of the mountain.

monolithics.name: Ethiopia: Shamma Cotton
monolithics.desc: Handspun gauze worn as a shawl, so fine that the border stripe is the only weight in it.

monolithics.name: Mali: Bogolan Mud
monolithics.desc: Cloth soaked in leaf tannin, then painted with fermented river mud — the iron fixes the black.

monolithics.name: Mali: Brass Casting
monolithics.desc: Lost wax: the model is destroyed to make the object, so every casting is the only one.

monolithics.name: Mali: Indigo Resist
monolithics.desc: Tied, stitched and dipped a dozen times. Each dip is darker and the resist never quite holds.

monolithics.name: Mali: Kente Strip
monolithics.desc: Woven in narrow strips on a men's loom, then sewn edge to edge so the pattern steps.

monolithics.name: Mali: Laterite Road
monolithics.desc: Iron-rich soil that sets like brick in the sun and turns the whole country red in the dry.

monolithics.name: Morocco: Atlas Cedar
monolithics.desc: Carved cedar ceilings, cut from trees that were old when the city was founded.

monolithics.name: Morocco: Saffron Souk
monolithics.desc: Cones of ground spice built by hand and rebuilt every morning after the wind gets at them.

monolithics.name: Morocco: Tadelakt
monolithics.desc: Lime plaster burnished with a river stone and sealed with black soap until it holds water.

monolithics.name: Morocco: Tannery Vats
monolithics.desc: Stone wells of dye and pigeon lime in Fez, worked exactly as they were in the eleventh century.

monolithics.name: Morocco: Zellij Star
monolithics.desc: Every piece chipped to shape by hand from a fired tile and set face-down into the bed.

monolithics.name: Brazil: Amazon Canopy
monolithics.desc: Closed canopy from above — a single surface made of ten thousand competing crowns.

monolithics.name: Brazil: Calçadão
monolithics.desc: Copacabana's black and white wave, laid stone by stone the length of the beach.

monolithics.name: Brazil: Carnival Block
monolithics.desc: Sequin, feather and float paint at four in the morning, all of it built to last one night.

monolithics.name: Brazil: Cocoa Pod
monolithics.desc: Ridged pods cut from the trunk itself, then fermented in banana leaf for a week.

monolithics.name: Brazil: Tourmaline
monolithics.desc: Watermelon crystal: green rind, white ring, pink core, all grown in one go.

monolithics.name: Cuba: Havana Facade
monolithics.desc: Colonial paint sixteen layers deep, each one failing to a different colour underneath.

monolithics.name: Cuba: Malecón Spray
monolithics.desc: Eight kilometres of sea wall and the Atlantic coming straight over it onto the road.

monolithics.name: Cuba: Sugar Crystal
monolithics.desc: Raw crystals off the centrifuge, still warm, still smelling of the cane field.

monolithics.name: Cuba: Tobacco Leaf
monolithics.desc: Vuelta Abajo wrapper, cured in a barn for fifty days until the veins go the colour of the leaf.

monolithics.name: Cuba: Vintage Lacquer
monolithics.desc: A '55 Bel Air kept alive for seventy years on house paint, marine varnish and stubbornness.

monolithics.name: Jamaica: Allspice Bark
monolithics.desc: Pimento — one tree that tastes like four spices, and the wood smokes the jerk pit.

monolithics.name: Jamaica: Blue Mountain
monolithics.desc: Cloud forest above 1500 metres, where the mist is what makes the coffee worth the price.

monolithics.name: Jamaica: Rasta Weave
monolithics.desc: Knitted bands in red, gold and green, worn as a tam and stretched by what is under it.

monolithics.name: Jamaica: Sea Glass
monolithics.desc: Bottle glass rolled by surf until the edges go and the surface frosts right through.

monolithics.name: Jamaica: Sound System
monolithics.desc: Scoops and tweeter boxes stacked to the ceiling, built by the crew that runs them.

monolithics.name: Peru: Alpaca Weave
monolithics.desc: Hollow fibre, warmer than wool and no lanolin in it, spun on a drop spindle while walking.

monolithics.name: Peru: Andes Strata
monolithics.desc: Rainbow Mountain: marine sediment, iron and copper folded upright and then stripped bare.

monolithics.name: Peru: Chicha Morada
monolithics.desc: Purple corn boiled with pineapple rind and clove until the colour is frankly unreasonable.

monolithics.name: Peru: Cusco Textile
monolithics.desc: Backstrap loom, warp-faced, so the pattern lives entirely in threads you never see cross.

monolithics.name: Peru: Salt Terrace
monolithics.desc: Maras: three thousand evaporation ponds fed by one warm spring, worked since before the Inca.

monolithics.name: Aotearoa: Black Sand
monolithics.desc: Titanomagnetite off the volcanoes, hot enough to burn your feet on a cloudy day.

monolithics.name: Aotearoa: Geothermal
monolithics.desc: Silica terraces and mud pots at Rotorua, rebuilt daily by water coming up too hot to touch.

monolithics.name: Aotearoa: Greenstone
monolithics.desc: Nephrite from the West Coast rivers, tougher than steel and worked only by abrasion.

monolithics.name: Aotearoa: Kauri Gum
monolithics.desc: Resin buried in swamp for thirty thousand years and dug out again with a spear.

monolithics.name: Aotearoa: Silver Fern
monolithics.desc: Ponga frond, white underneath, laid face-down to mark a track you can follow by moonlight.

monolithics.name: Australia: Desert Varnish
monolithics.desc: Manganese and clay laid on rock by microbes at a micron a millennium, and it shines.

monolithics.name: Australia: Eucalypt Bark
monolithics.desc: Ribbon gum shedding in long strips, leaving fresh green-grey skin underneath.

monolithics.name: Australia: Ochre Bed
monolithics.desc: Iron oxide laid down in bands and quarried for forty thousand years as pigment.

monolithics.name: Australia: Opal Seam
monolithics.desc: Silica spheres stacked regularly enough to diffract — the fire is structure, not pigment.

monolithics.name: Australia: Salt Pan
monolithics.desc: Lake Eyre dry: a crust that polygonises as it shrinks and floods once a decade.

monolithics.name: Indonesia: Batik Wax
monolithics.desc: Drawn in hot wax with a canting, dyed, boiled off, and drawn again for the next colour.

monolithics.name: Indonesia: Ikat Warp
monolithics.desc: The thread is dyed before it is woven, so the design arrives already blurred. That IS the craft.

monolithics.name: Indonesia: Spice Heap
monolithics.desc: Nutmeg and mace from islands the world fought a war over. Two spices, one seed.

monolithics.name: Indonesia: Teak Grain
monolithics.desc: Oil in the grain itself, which is why a teak deck survives what it survives.

monolithics.name: Indonesia: Volcanic Sand
monolithics.desc: Ash from a caldera that emptied itself, farmed within a decade because nothing grows better.

monolithics.name: Philippines: Abaca Fibre
monolithics.desc: Banana-family fibre strong enough to have rigged the world's ships, woven here into cloth.

monolithics.name: Philippines: Capiz Shell
monolithics.desc: Windowpane oyster cut into squares and set in wooden lattice, translucent and cool.

monolithics.name: Philippines: Jeepney Chrome
monolithics.desc: Stainless bodywork, hand-cut trim and more paint than the mechanicals are worth.

monolithics.name: Philippines: Mayon Ash
monolithics.desc: The most perfect cone on earth, and the ash fall that keeps it that shape.

monolithics.name: Philippines: Rice Terrace
monolithics.desc: Two thousand years of contour walls at Banaue, still fed by the same irrigation.

monolithics.name: Mint: Denomination Foil
monolithics.desc: The holographic patch, stamped in register and struck through with rose-engine work.

monolithics.name: Mint: Fresh Sheet
monolithics.desc: Thirty-two notes to a sheet, uncut, before the guillotine ever touches them.

monolithics.name: Mint: Intaglio Plate
monolithics.desc: Line engraving with the ink standing proud of the paper — the one security feature you check with a thumbnail.

monolithics.name: Mint: Microtext Field
monolithics.desc: Lettering below the resolution of any copier, woven into a field of language you can almost read.

monolithics.name: Mint: Optically Variable
monolithics.desc: Ink with interference flakes in it — the denomination that changes colour when the car turns.

monolithics.name: Mint: Rose Engine
monolithics.desc: A lathe that cuts interfering rosettes no hand can redraw. The machine is called a rose engine; this is its output.

monolithics.name: Mint: Security Thread
monolithics.desc: A metal ribbon buried in the pulp, surfacing through windows, with the mill's loose fibres scattered around it.

monolithics.name: Mint: Watermark Pulp
monolithics.desc: Not printed at all — the dandy roll pressed the pulp thinner, and the portrait is a map of paper thickness.

monolithics.name: Vault: Armoured Glass
monolithics.desc: Laminate that stops the round and keeps the spall, cracked into a web that holds together.

monolithics.name: Vault: Bullion Stack
monolithics.desc: Four hundred troy ounces a bar, stacked five high, each one softer than you expect.

monolithics.name: Vault: Cage Mesh
monolithics.desc: Expanded steel between you and the money, close enough to see through and not to reach through.

monolithics.name: Vault: Deposit Brass
monolithics.desc: A wall of safe-deposit doors, every one with a name on it and two locks.

monolithics.name: Vault: Hardplate
monolithics.desc: Manganese hardplate — the layer a drill bit dies in. Cross-cut so the carbide skates.

monolithics.name: Vault: Night Deposit
monolithics.desc: The chute in the wall, painted the green every bank painted everything until 1979.

monolithics.name: Vault: Tamper Seal
monolithics.desc: A seal designed to destroy itself: void lettering that surfaces the instant anyone lifts an edge.

monolithics.name: Vault: Timelock
monolithics.desc: Clockwork that refuses to open before morning, in polished brass and jewelled bearings.

monolithics.name: Asset: Bearer Deed
monolithics.desc: Whoever holds the paper owns the thing. No name on it anywhere, which is exactly the point.

monolithics.name: Asset: Brilliant Cut
monolithics.desc: Fifty-seven facets arranged so light that goes in has to come back at you.

monolithics.name: Asset: Bullion Pour
monolithics.desc: Molten gold entering a mould — the moment before it becomes a number in a ledger.

monolithics.name: Asset: Leaf Gilding
monolithics.desc: Gold beaten to a fifth of a micron, laid down in leaves that never quite meet.

monolithics.name: Asset: Platinum Ingot
monolithics.desc: Denser than gold, rarer than gold, and it does not care what you think of it.

monolithics.name: Asset: Share Certificate
monolithics.desc: An engraved allegory of Industry, a serial number, and a claim on something you will never see.

monolithics.name: Asset: Title Vellum
monolithics.desc: Calfskin, a wax seal and a hand that has been dust for two centuries. Still enforceable.

monolithics.name: Asset: Watch Movement
monolithics.desc: Côtes de Genève on a bridge nobody will ever look at, because it should be right anyway.

monolithics.name: Counterfeit: Bleached Note
monolithics.desc: A one washed to blank and reprinted as a hundred. The paper is genuine, which is the clever part.

monolithics.name: Counterfeit: Laundered
monolithics.desc: Through a restaurant, a car wash and a shell in Nicosia, and it comes out the other side clean.

monolithics.name: Counterfeit: Plated Brass
monolithics.desc: Two microns of gold over brass, and it wears through exactly where a thumb would rest.

monolithics.name: Counterfeit: Rescreened
monolithics.desc: Photographed and reprinted. The scanner's grid beat against the engraving and left its confession.

monolithics.name: Counterfeit: Salted Bar
monolithics.desc: Right weight, right stamp, tungsten core. It only fails the one test nobody runs.

monolithics.name: Counterfeit: Superdollar
monolithics.desc: State-made, intaglio-printed, better paper than the original. The engraving is only wrong in one line.

monolithics.name: Counterfeit: UV Dead
monolithics.desc: Perfect in daylight. Under the lamp at the till, the fibres that should light up stay black.

monolithics.name: Counterfeit: Wrong Watermark
monolithics.desc: Printed on, not pressed in. It reads correctly flat and vanishes the moment you hold it up.

monolithics.name: Burn: Bond Ash
monolithics.desc: Cold ash holding the shape of the certificate right up until the moment you touch it.

monolithics.name: Burn: Burn A Stack
monolithics.desc: A strapped brick going up all at once — the scorch corona running ahead of the black.

monolithics.name: Burn: Confetti Drop
monolithics.desc: A year's bonus turned into ticker tape and thrown off a balcony.

monolithics.name: Burn: Cross Cut
monolithics.desc: Security-grade shredding: 2mm strips, cross-cut, unreconstructable and oddly beautiful.

monolithics.name: Burn: Hyperinflation
monolithics.desc: A hundred trillion of something, printed on one side because the second pass costs more than the note.

monolithics.name: Burn: Ink Spill
monolithics.desc: The dye pack goes off in the bag and marks every note, and the money is still money and worth nothing.

monolithics.name: Burn: Ticker Crash
monolithics.desc: Tape running faster than anyone can read it, all of it in one direction.

monolithics.name: Burn: Torn In Half
monolithics.desc: Half a note is worth nothing, so tearing one is the purest way to spend money on a gesture.

monolithics.name: Woven: Burlap Glaze
monolithics.desc: Open-weave sacking, glazed as though it had been through a kiln.

monolithics.name: Woven: Canvas Pearl
monolithics.desc: Artist's canvas, sized and stretched, behaving like a tri-coat pearl.

monolithics.name: Woven: Corduroy Liquid
monolithics.desc: Wales running true down the panel, and each one is a standing wave of liquid.

monolithics.name: Woven: Denim Chrome
monolithics.desc: Twill you could count the picks on, and every one of them is a mirror.

monolithics.name: Woven: Felt Carrier
monolithics.desc: Pressed fibre, no weave at all — and it thresholds under a floodlight like cut metal.

monolithics.name: Woven: Hessian Mercury
monolithics.desc: Coarse jute sacking, thread for thread — machined out of a single block of mercury.

monolithics.name: Woven: Knit Liquid
monolithics.desc: Every loop of the knit intact, and the whole surface still moving.

monolithics.name: Woven: Silk Carrier
monolithics.desc: Cloth caught mid-drape, made of a material that only exists after dark.

monolithics.name: Woven: Tweed Mirror
monolithics.desc: Flecked country cloth with the optics of a polished ingot.

monolithics.name: Woven: Wool Glass
monolithics.desc: Carded wool with the surface tension of poured glass.

monolithics.name: Grown: Bark Chrome
monolithics.desc: Deep fissured bark you could put your fingers into, mirror-polished.

monolithics.name: Grown: Coral Glass
monolithics.desc: A calcified reef, still porous, and clear all the way through.

monolithics.name: Grown: Fur Carrier
monolithics.desc: Dense pelt lying one way, which under lights behaves like the Fractured rail.

monolithics.name: Grown: Hide Pearl
monolithics.desc: Full-grain leather with its pores intact, finished as a pearl coat.

monolithics.name: Grown: Leaf Liquid
monolithics.desc: Venation from midrib to margin, and the whole leaf is still pouring.

monolithics.name: Grown: Lichen Mercury
monolithics.desc: Crustose lichen spreading on rock, rendered as a liquid metal colony.

monolithics.name: Grown: Moss Glass
monolithics.desc: Sphagnum, every frond resolved, cast in optical glass.

monolithics.name: Grown: Petal Liquid
