monolithics.desc: Petal tissue with the light behaving as though the flower were poured.

monolithics.name: Grown: Root Mercury
monolithics.desc: A root mat pulled out of the soil intact, every hair of it liquid metal.

monolithics.name: Grown: Spore Pearl
monolithics.desc: A fruiting mat gone velvet — and finished like a show car.

monolithics.name: Mineral: Basalt Mirror
monolithics.desc: Columnar basalt in plan view, each column a perfect mirror.

monolithics.name: Mineral: Chalk Chrome
monolithics.desc: Blackboard chalk — the most matte thing there is — polished to a mirror.

monolithics.name: Mineral: Concrete Liquid
monolithics.desc: Board-marked concrete with the aggregate showing, and it has not set.

monolithics.name: Mineral: Granite Mercury
monolithics.desc: Coarse-grained granite, every crystal visible, machined out of mercury.

monolithics.name: Mineral: Grit Carrier
monolithics.desc: Blasting grit at rest, which after dark stops behaving like a mineral at all.

monolithics.name: Mineral: Gypsum Glass
monolithics.desc: Fibrous gypsum — satin spar — taken all the way to optical clarity.

monolithics.name: Mineral: Pumice Pearl
monolithics.desc: Volcanic foam, light enough to float, finished like a concours pearl.

monolithics.name: Mineral: Sandstone Liquid
monolithics.desc: Cross-bedded sandstone with every lamina readable, and it is flowing.

monolithics.name: Mineral: Slate Glass
monolithics.desc: Riven slate, split along its cleavage, and completely transparent.

monolithics.name: Mineral: Terracotta Carrier
monolithics.desc: Unglazed fired clay that ignites into the carrier the moment lights hit it.

monolithics.name: Made: Blotter Glass
monolithics.desc: Absorbent blotting stock, which drinks light and somehow also transmits it.

monolithics.name: Made: Card Pearl
monolithics.desc: Folded card stock with the crease still crisp, sprayed like a show finish.

monolithics.name: Made: Chipboard Liquid
monolithics.desc: Pressed chip and resin, every flake showing, in the middle of pouring.

monolithics.name: Made: Cork Pearl
monolithics.desc: Cellular cork, every cell open, finished as a three-stage pearl.

monolithics.name: Made: Corrugate Mercury
monolithics.desc: Single-wall board with the flutes running true — poured, not folded.

monolithics.name: Made: Greyboard Carrier
monolithics.desc: Book board. The dullest material in any workshop, and it fractures under light.

monolithics.name: Made: Kraft Chrome
monolithics.desc: Unbleached kraft paper with the fibre lay visible, and it is solid chrome.

monolithics.name: Made: Newsprint Glass
monolithics.desc: Cheap paper stock, showing its screen, and clear as a lens.

monolithics.name: Made: Plywood Liquid
monolithics.desc: Rotary-cut veneer with the grain sweeping across it, and it has not stopped moving.

monolithics.name: Made: Sawdust Mirror
monolithics.desc: Swarf and dust from the saw, every particle a facet.

monolithics.name: Ruined: Ash Chrome
monolithics.desc: Cold wood ash. Nothing on earth reflects less, and this reflects everything.

monolithics.name: Ruined: Cinder Mirror
monolithics.desc: Burnt-out clinker from the bottom of a grate, polished like jewellery.

monolithics.name: Ruined: Corrosion Glass
monolithics.desc: Pitting corrosion eating into the metal, and each pit is a lens.

monolithics.name: Ruined: Decay Pearl
monolithics.desc: Rot doing its work, finished to a standard the object never had when new.

monolithics.name: Ruined: Flake Carrier
monolithics.desc: Failing paint curling off the substrate, each flake carrying the Fractured rail.

monolithics.name: Ruined: Mould Liquid
monolithics.desc: A colony spreading across a damp wall, and the whole wall is running.

monolithics.name: Ruined: Rust Mirror
monolithics.desc: Scaling iron oxide lifting off in plates, and every plate is a mirror.

monolithics.name: Ruined: Soot Pearl
monolithics.desc: Carbon black, the deadest pigment there is, laid down as a pearl.

monolithics.name: Ruined: Verdigris Glass
monolithics.desc: Copper carbonate crusting a roof, and you can see straight through it.

monolithics.name: Ruined: Weathered Liquid
monolithics.desc: Timber silvered by forty years of weather, and it is pouring off the panel.

monolithics.name: Rain: Downpour
monolithics.desc: Rain hard enough to be a surface of its own, and the road answering it.

monolithics.name: Rain: Cloudburst
monolithics.desc: Every drop lands at once — a whole sheet of overlapping impact rings.

monolithics.name: Rain: Drizzle
monolithics.desc: Too fine to hear, wet enough to soak you. Rain you only see against a light.

monolithics.name: Rain: Sheet Rain
monolithics.desc: Wind-driven and near-horizontal, arriving in visible sheets across the tarmac.

monolithics.name: Rain: Monsoon
monolithics.desc: A season, not a shower — warm rain with the whole sky committed to it.

monolithics.name: Rain: Acid Rain
monolithics.desc: Rain that leaves a mark: etched pits where each drop sat and worked.

monolithics.name: Rain: Puddle Skin
monolithics.desc: Standing water with the wind fretting it and oil-film drifting on top.

monolithics.name: Rain: Dew Field
monolithics.desc: Condensation beaded on cold paint, each bead its own tiny lens.

monolithics.name: Rain: Petrichor
monolithics.desc: Dry ground taking the first rain — dark patches spreading and joining.

monolithics.name: Rain: Gutter Race
monolithics.desc: Water finding the low line and running it faster than anything else on the road.

monolithics.name: Rain: Windscreen
monolithics.desc: Beads shearing sideways and joining into rivulets the moment you move.

monolithics.name: Rain: Virga
monolithics.desc: Rain that never lands — it evaporates on the way down and hangs there instead.

monolithics.name: Frozen: Blizzard
monolithics.desc: Snow moving sideways fast enough that the ground and the sky stop being different.

monolithics.name: Frozen: Snowdrift
monolithics.desc: Wind sculpting snow the same way it sculpts sand, and just as sharply.

monolithics.name: Frozen: Sleet
monolithics.desc: Half rain, half ice, and unpleasant in a way neither of them manages alone.

monolithics.name: Frozen: Hail Damage
monolithics.desc: Dents you can feel through the paint, each one a stone that fell out of a cloud.

monolithics.name: Frozen: Hoarfrost
monolithics.desc: Water going straight from vapour to crystal, feathering out on every cold edge.

monolithics.name: Frozen: Rime Ice
monolithics.desc: Freezing fog building into the wind, so the ice grows toward the weather.

monolithics.name: Frozen: Black Ice
monolithics.desc: Invisible until it is far too late — clear ice over dark tarmac.

monolithics.name: Frozen: Frost Fern
monolithics.desc: Window frost: ferns that grow along scratches you never knew the glass had.

monolithics.name: Frozen: Diamond Dust
monolithics.desc: Ice crystals falling out of a clear sky, each one catching the sun on its way.

monolithics.name: Frozen: Permafrost
monolithics.desc: Ground that has not thawed in ten thousand years, cracked into contraction polygons.

monolithics.name: Frozen: Serac Field
monolithics.desc: A glacier breaking over a step: blocks the size of houses, none of them stable.

monolithics.name: Frozen: Graupel
monolithics.desc: Soft hail — snowflakes that fell through supercooled cloud and came out rimed.

monolithics.name: Storm: Tornado Alley
monolithics.desc: Rotation you can see. The field turns before the funnel ever touches down.

monolithics.name: Storm: Supercell
monolithics.desc: One storm with its own rotating updraught, which is why it lasts all afternoon.

monolithics.name: Storm: Hurricane Eye
monolithics.desc: Bands wrapped tight enough to leave a hole in the middle where it is completely calm.

monolithics.name: Storm: Squall Line
monolithics.desc: A wall of weather a hundred miles long arriving all at once.

monolithics.name: Storm: Gust Front
monolithics.desc: The cold air a storm pushes ahead of itself, rolling and picking up everything loose.

monolithics.name: Storm: Mammatus
monolithics.desc: Pouches hanging under the anvil — sinking air, and a sky that looks upside down.

monolithics.name: Storm: Wall Cloud
monolithics.desc: The lowered base under the updraught. If anything is going to happen, it happens here.

monolithics.name: Storm: Lightning Strike
monolithics.desc: One channel out of a thousand attempts, and it lasts about thirty microseconds.

monolithics.name: Storm: Thunderhead
monolithics.desc: Twelve kilometres of vertical development, flattened at the top where it hit the stratosphere.

monolithics.name: Storm: Microburst
monolithics.desc: Air falling out of a cloud fast enough to spread sideways when it lands.

monolithics.name: Storm: Waterspout
monolithics.desc: A tornado that found the sea and started lifting it.

monolithics.name: Storm: Derecho
monolithics.desc: Straight-line wind that keeps going for six hundred miles without rotating once.

monolithics.name: Water: Tsunami
monolithics.desc: Not a wave — a change in sea level that happens to be moving at jet speed.

monolithics.name: Water: Breaker
monolithics.desc: The moment the wave face outruns its own base and the top has nowhere to go.

monolithics.name: Water: Whitewater
monolithics.desc: Air beaten into water until it stops being either one.

monolithics.name: Water: Tide Race
monolithics.desc: A whole ocean forced through a gap, and the seams where the flows shear past each other.

monolithics.name: Water: Storm Surge
monolithics.desc: The sea arriving somewhere it does not belong, pushed by a low-pressure centre.

monolithics.name: Water: Riptide
monolithics.desc: A narrow river running out through the surf, and the reason you swim sideways.

monolithics.name: Water: Spindrift
monolithics.desc: Spray torn off the wave tops and carried until it is more air than water.

monolithics.name: Water: Whirlpool
monolithics.desc: Two tides meeting on a shelf and neither of them giving way.

monolithics.name: Water: Chop
monolithics.desc: Short, steep, confused water — the wind arguing with the swell underneath it.

monolithics.name: Water: Glassy Swell
monolithics.desc: Long-period energy from a storm a thousand miles away, arriving in perfect order.

monolithics.name: Water: Flood Line
monolithics.desc: Silt and debris marking exactly how high it got, all the way along.

monolithics.name: Water: Foam Lace
monolithics.desc: What is left on the sand after the wave goes back — a lace of bubbles, briefly.

monolithics.name: Dry: Sandstorm
monolithics.desc: Visibility measured in metres, and the sound of your own paint being taken off.

monolithics.name: Dry: Haboob
monolithics.desc: A wall of dust a mile high rolling ahead of a collapsing thunderstorm.

monolithics.name: Dry: Dust Devil
monolithics.desc: Ground heated until the air above it has to leave, spinning as it goes.

monolithics.name: Dry: Heat Shimmer
monolithics.desc: Air of two different densities in the same place, and the road bending because of it.

monolithics.name: Dry: Drought Crack
monolithics.desc: Clay that has given up all its water and shrunk away from itself.

monolithics.name: Dry: Mirage
monolithics.desc: An inverted image of the sky lying on the road, and it stays exactly as far away.

monolithics.name: Dry: Dust Veil
monolithics.desc: Fine enough to stay up for weeks and to make the sunsets worth watching.

monolithics.name: Dry: Salt Haze
monolithics.desc: A dry lake giving its crust back to the wind one flake at a time.

monolithics.name: Dry: Harmattan
monolithics.desc: A trade wind carrying the Sahara west until it reaches the sea and beyond.

monolithics.name: Dry: Sirocco
monolithics.desc: Desert air pulled north across the Mediterranean, arriving hot and full of grit.

monolithics.name: Dry: Loess
monolithics.desc: Windblown silt laid down in beds deep enough to farm and soft enough to carve.

monolithics.name: Dry: Brownout
monolithics.desc: Rotor wash lifting the whole surface at once, and the ground disappearing from under you.

monolithics.name: Contact: Saucer Alloy
monolithics.desc: Spun machined hull: concentric turn-rings still on the alloy from the lathe that made it.

monolithics.name: Contact: Hull Plating
monolithics.desc: Irregular alien plates, recessed seams, fastener rows, and no two panels polished alike.

monolithics.name: Contact: Glyph Script
monolithics.desc: Angular xeno writing — strokes cluster into words, so it reads as language, not scatter.

monolithics.name: Contact: Crop Geometry
monolithics.desc: Flattened agroglyph rings laid across a standing crop that all leans one way.

monolithics.name: Contact: Abduction Column
monolithics.desc: A leaning forest of light columns with the dust caught turning inside them.

monolithics.name: Contact: Tractor Well
monolithics.desc: Beam wells pulsing tight concentric pull-rings into whatever is underneath.

monolithics.name: Contact: Bio-Mech Chitin
monolithics.desc: Interlocking chitin plate and the vein bundles running between them. Grown, not built.

monolithics.name: Contact: Reactor Lattice
monolithics.desc: An isometric strut scaffold with the containment charge running the struts.

monolithics.name: Contact: Beacon Array
monolithics.desc: Emitter grid mid-broadcast: every cell on its own phase of the same signal.

monolithics.name: Contact: Cloaking Field
monolithics.desc: The hull half-there: a refractive skin that bends the background instead of hiding it.

monolithics.name: Contact: Probe Skin
monolithics.desc: Sensor pits and apertures sunk flush into a plated skin that has been out there a while.

monolithics.name: Contact: Signal Bloom
monolithics.desc: A transmission leaving: expanding wavefronts stacked over the antenna that threw them.

monolithics.name: Worlds: Regolith
monolithics.desc: Four billion years of impact gardening: dust turned over so often it has no bedrock left.

monolithics.name: Worlds: Crater Field
monolithics.desc: Big enough to have rims and ejecta blankets, and each one has been hit again since.

monolithics.name: Worlds: Ice Moon
monolithics.desc: A shell of ice cracked and re-frozen so many times the lines cross their own history.

monolithics.name: Worlds: Sulfur Volcanics
monolithics.desc: Sulfur flows in every allotrope colour, laid down and buried on a world that never stops.

monolithics.name: Worlds: Gas Giant Bands
monolithics.desc: Zonal flow: belts running the opposite way to their neighbours, with storms caught between.

monolithics.name: Worlds: Storm Oval
monolithics.desc: An anticyclone that has outlived every telescope pointed at it, kept fed by the shear.

monolithics.name: Worlds: Dune Sea
monolithics.desc: Barchan dunes all marching the same way because one wind has had the whole planet to itself.

monolithics.name: Worlds: Salt Flat
monolithics.desc: Evaporite polygons: the floor of a sea that left, cracked into plates as it dried.

monolithics.name: Worlds: Basalt Plain
monolithics.desc: Flood basalt with wrinkle ridges — a lava ocean that cooled and then shrugged.

monolithics.name: Worlds: Methane Lake
monolithics.desc: Dark hydrocarbon under an orange haze, with a shoreline that rain keeps redrawing.

monolithics.name: Worlds: Ring Shadow
monolithics.desc: The ring system printing its own gaps onto the cloud deck below it.

monolithics.name: Worlds: Terminator
monolithics.desc: The line where the sun is setting: every crater rim throwing a shadow the length of itself.

monolithics.name: Deep Field: Star Nursery
monolithics.desc: Pillars being eaten from the outside by the stars they just finished making.

monolithics.name: Deep Field: Emission Nebula
monolithics.desc: Hydrogen ionised by everything young and hot inside it, glowing at one wavelength.

monolithics.name: Deep Field: Dark Nebula
monolithics.desc: Not empty — full. Cold dust thick enough to delete the stars behind it.

monolithics.name: Deep Field: Globular Cluster
monolithics.desc: A hundred thousand old stars packed so tightly the sky there never gets dark.

monolithics.name: Deep Field: Spiral Arm
monolithics.desc: A density wave, not a structure — the arm stays put while the stars pass through.

monolithics.name: Deep Field: Dust Lane
monolithics.desc: The dark band across a galaxy's face, edge-on and absolutely opaque.

monolithics.name: Deep Field: Deep Field
monolithics.desc: Point the telescope at nothing for eleven days and this is what nothing turns out to be.

monolithics.name: Deep Field: Reflection Nebula
monolithics.desc: Dust that is not glowing at all — only scattering blue light from a star out of frame.

monolithics.name: Deep Field: Planetary Nebula
monolithics.desc: A dying star's outer shell thrown off in stages, lit from inside by the core it left.

monolithics.name: Deep Field: Filament Web
monolithics.desc: Large-scale structure: galaxies strung on filaments around voids the size of nothing else.

monolithics.name: Deep Field: Zodiacal Light
monolithics.desc: Sunlight scattered off the dust in our own plane — the faintest thing you can see.

monolithics.name: Deep Field: Molecular Cloud
monolithics.desc: Cold, clumpy, and barely holding together — every clump a star that has not decided yet.

monolithics.name: Event: Event Horizon
monolithics.desc: The photon ring: light that went round more than once before it got out.

monolithics.name: Event: Accretion Disc
monolithics.desc: Gas shearing against itself on the way in, and getting hot enough to be the brightest thing here.

monolithics.name: Event: Gravitational Lens
monolithics.desc: Arcs and rings — the same galaxy, imaged four times by the mass in front of it.

monolithics.name: Event: Wormhole Throat
monolithics.desc: Nested funnels where the geometry stops agreeing with the distance.

monolithics.name: Event: Supernova Remnant
monolithics.desc: Ragged filament shells still expanding into whatever the star's wind cleared out first.

monolithics.name: Event: Pulsar Beam
monolithics.desc: A lighthouse turning thirty times a second, and you only exist when the beam is on you.

monolithics.name: Event: Magnetar Flare
monolithics.desc: Field lines snapping and reconnecting on a crust that just cracked.

monolithics.name: Event: Relativistic Jet
monolithics.desc: Collimated, knotted, and moving at a speed that makes the far side of it invisible.

monolithics.name: Event: Bow Shock
monolithics.desc: Where something moving fast meets something already there, and the medium piles up.

monolithics.name: Event: Tidal Stream
monolithics.desc: A companion galaxy pulled into a thread and wound round its own host.

monolithics.name: Event: Kilonova
monolithics.desc: Two neutron stars finished. Every heavy element in your body was made in one of these.

monolithics.name: Event: Frame Drag
monolithics.desc: Spacetime itself wound up by the rotation, so standing still is no longer available.

monolithics.name: Vessel: Heat Shield
monolithics.desc: Ablative char: the shield works by being destroyed at a rate somebody calculated exactly.

monolithics.name: Vessel: MLI Foil
monolithics.desc: Multi-layer insulation, crumpled gold — the crinkles are the point, not damage.

monolithics.name: Vessel: Solar Sail
monolithics.desc: A membrane thinner than a bin bag and the size of a football pitch, pushed by light.

monolithics.name: Vessel: Radiator Panel
monolithics.desc: White honeycomb whose whole job is to be cold, facing the direction with nothing in it.

monolithics.name: Vessel: Whipple Shield
monolithics.desc: Sacrificial outer layer, pitted by grains travelling at ten kilometres a second.

monolithics.name: Vessel: Thermal Blanket
monolithics.desc: Quilted kapton, stitched into cells so a puncture stays a puncture and not a tear.

monolithics.name: Vessel: Sun Shade
monolithics.desc: Five layers, each one colder than the last, holding a mirror at forty kelvin.

monolithics.name: Vessel: Mirror Segment
monolithics.desc: Gold on beryllium, eighteen hexagons aligned to a fraction of the light they collect.

monolithics.name: Vessel: Docking Ring
monolithics.desc: A machined collar built so two things moving at eight kilometres a second can touch gently.

monolithics.name: Vessel: Ablation Streak
monolithics.desc: Re-entry flow written onto the shield: every streak is where the plasma went.

monolithics.name: Vessel: Cryo Tank
monolithics.desc: Frost creeping over insulation, because the thing inside is colder than the sky.

monolithics.name: Vessel: Beacon Strobe
monolithics.desc: Anti-collision strobe on a hull that nothing is close enough to collide with.

monolithics.name: Cyanide Hour
monolithics.desc: Teal all day; at the first floodlight it turns to hot copper and stays there.

monolithics.name: Ember Verdict
monolithics.desc: Slate blue with a filament network that only announces itself as ember after dark.

monolithics.name: Violet Sentence
monolithics.desc: Sober olive by day, liquid violet by night — the braid does the handing over.

monolithics.name: Copper Confession
monolithics.desc: Sea-green drift that confesses to copper under the lights.

monolithics.name: Magenta Testimony
monolithics.desc: A chalk-green plate whose crack network burns magenta at night.

monolithics.name: Ice to Rust
monolithics.desc: Lifted ice plates that oxidise the moment the sun leaves.

monolithics.name: Jade Reversal
monolithics.desc: Jade cells, rose-mirror seams — the two never appear together.

monolithics.name: Sodium Trial
monolithics.desc: Cold blue bed with sodium-lamp amber waiting inside it.

monolithics.name: Aqua Betrayal
monolithics.desc: An aqua burn front that turns blood-red under a point light.

monolithics.name: Chartreuse Alibi
monolithics.desc: Acid-green powder coat; the dendrites hold an indigo alibi for after dark.

monolithics.name: Slate Ember
monolithics.desc: Creased slate that keeps a bed of embers in every fold.

monolithics.name: Harbour Amber
monolithics.desc: Cold harbour grey braided with the amber of the dock lamps.

monolithics.name: Gunsmoke Coal
monolithics.desc: Gunsmoke plates with coal-red heat surviving underneath them.

monolithics.name: Frost Filament
monolithics.desc: Frosted ceramic threaded with filaments that light warm.

monolithics.name: Deep Water Forge
monolithics.desc: Deep-water drift with a forge glow under the surface.

monolithics.name: Pewter Sunset
monolithics.desc: Pewter cells that each hold one sunset.

monolithics.name: Storm Copper
monolithics.desc: Storm-grey fingering shot through with old copper.

monolithics.name: Blue Hour Brass
monolithics.desc: The blue hour, cracked, with brass in every fracture.

monolithics.name: Cinder Vault
monolithics.desc: A near-black vault whose floor is entirely cinder once the lamps come on.

monolithics.name: Anchor Rust
monolithics.desc: Cold anchor grey overtaken by a rust front after dark.

monolithics.name: Rust to Glacier
monolithics.desc: Rusted plate by day; every lifted edge goes glacier blue at night.

monolithics.name: Amber Cryonic
monolithics.desc: Amber cells with a cryogenic mirror sleeping in the seams.

monolithics.name: Terracotta Freeze
monolithics.desc: Terracotta that freezes solid the moment the sun drops.

monolithics.name: Bronze Nocturne
monolithics.desc: Bronze braid playing a blue nocturne after hours.

monolithics.name: Saffron Midnight
monolithics.desc: Saffron ground, midnight veins — they trade places at dusk.

monolithics.name: Ochre Arctic
monolithics.desc: Ochre drift with arctic light moving under it.

monolithics.name: Foundry Frost
monolithics.desc: Foundry heat by day, frost in the creases by night.

monolithics.name: Marigold Abyss
monolithics.desc: A marigold bed that opens onto an abyss-blue floor.

monolithics.name: Sienna Signal
monolithics.desc: Sienna field with cold signal sparks that only fire at night.

monolithics.name: Kiln Blue
monolithics.desc: A kiln-warm front that cools to blue behind it.

monolithics.name: Venom Curfew
monolithics.desc: Purple curfew broken by acid-green dendrites after dark.

monolithics.name: Absinthe Night
monolithics.desc: Rose by day; absinthe threads take the whole car at night.

monolithics.name: Toxic Recess
monolithics.desc: Indigo recess cells with a toxic charge in the walls.

monolithics.name: Chlorine Watch
monolithics.desc: Pool-blue watch that turns chlorine-green under the lamps.

monolithics.name: Lime Interrogation
monolithics.desc: Violet powder coat, lime in every crack — nothing stays hidden.

monolithics.name: Serpent Shift
monolithics.desc: Magenta braid that sheds into serpent green.

monolithics.name: Uranium Dusk
monolithics.desc: Cold plates over a uranium glow that only shows at the edges.

monolithics.name: Wormwood Vigil
monolithics.desc: A mauve vigil drifting toward wormwood by midnight.

monolithics.name: Acid Testament
monolithics.desc: Blue-violet fingering with an acid testament underneath.

monolithics.name: Hemlock Hour
monolithics.desc: Orchid front, hemlock behind it, and one hour where you see both.

monolithics.name: Royal Nightfall
monolithics.desc: Olive court by day; royal violet takes the throne at night.

monolithics.name: Rose Assize
monolithics.desc: Green bench, rose verdict — the veins deliver it.

monolithics.name: Gilt Sentence
monolithics.desc: Cold ceramic sentenced to gilt after dark.

monolithics.name: Imperial Drift
monolithics.desc: Imperial drift from moss to amethyst as the light fails.

monolithics.name: Orchid Curfew
monolithics.desc: A yellow-green braid that closes into orchid at curfew.

monolithics.name: Cardinal Watch
monolithics.desc: Green watch-plates, cardinal red beneath every lifted edge.

monolithics.name: Amethyst Bench
monolithics.desc: A powder-green bed with amethyst working up through it.

monolithics.name: Coronation Blue
monolithics.desc: Gold creases at noon, coronation blue by ten.

monolithics.name: Fuchsia Docket
monolithics.desc: Fern ground with fuchsia sparks that only strike at night.

monolithics.name: Last Session
monolithics.desc: The last session of the day: sea-green gives way to crimson mirror.

monolithics.name: Ignition: Flashpoint
monolithics.desc: The instant it catches — a ragged burn front with the first embers already thrown clear.

monolithics.name: Ignition: Char Creep
monolithics.desc: Blackening crawls across the surface along the grain, carbon dendrites trailing behind it.

monolithics.name: Ignition: Tinder Bloom
monolithics.desc: Dry fibre catching all at once: hundreds of thin bright threads opening out of a rough front.

monolithics.name: Ignition: Match Head
monolithics.desc: Crimson strontium flare — the chemical head burning ahead of the wood.

monolithics.name: Ignition: Smoulder Bed
monolithics.desc: Heat travelling underground through a packed bed, glowing only where it found air.

monolithics.name: Ignition: Fuse Line
monolithics.desc: Lilac potassium running along a powder trail, spitting as it goes.

monolithics.name: Ignition: Kindle Lattice
monolithics.desc: Stacked kindling seen from above, each cell lighting on its own schedule.

monolithics.name: Ignition: Spark Shower
monolithics.desc: White-gold thermite spray, every particle burning out along its own arc.

monolithics.name: Ignition: Ember Catch
monolithics.desc: A landed ember taking hold — bright cores spreading into the cold bed around them.

monolithics.name: Ignition: Pilot Ring
monolithics.desc: The blue pilot crown: cool methane braids holding a steady standing flame.

monolithics.name: Ignition: Autoignition
monolithics.desc: No spark needed — the whole surface reaches temperature at once and creases as it goes.

monolithics.name: Ignition: Firebrand Scatter
monolithics.desc: Burning debris carried downwind, each brand starting a new small front where it lands.

monolithics.name: Ignition: Scorch Front
monolithics.desc: The dark boundary between what has burned and what has not, creased by its own heat.

monolithics.name: Ignition: Ignition Delay
monolithics.desc: Fuel and air mixed but not yet lit — pale sulfur blue drifting over a cold bed.

monolithics.name: Ignition: Touchpaper
monolithics.desc: Amber sodium creeping through treated paper along every fibre at once.

monolithics.name: Flame: Diffusion Sheet
monolithics.desc: Where fuel meets air the burn is a SURFACE, not a volume — a shoal of thin reaction sheets.

monolithics.name: Flame: Wrinkled Front
monolithics.desc: Michelson-Sivashinsky cusping: a flame front unstable to its own curvature, creasing everywhere.

monolithics.name: Flame: Darrieus Cell
monolithics.desc: Darrieus-Landau cellular instability — a premixed flame breaking into its own honeycomb.

monolithics.name: Flame: Turbulent Braid
monolithics.desc: Shear at the flame edge rolling into braid after braid, never one big billow.

monolithics.name: Flame: Flamelet Storm
monolithics.desc: Turbulence tears the front into thousands of independent flamelets, each burning on its own.

monolithics.name: Flame: Buoyant Fingers
monolithics.desc: Rayleigh-Taylor: hot gas punching up through cold in a hundred small fingers.

monolithics.name: Flame: Shear Tongue
monolithics.desc: Amber tongues leaning off a shear layer, licked into ribbons by the crossflow.

monolithics.name: Flame: Pool Puff
monolithics.desc: A pool fire breathing — the periodic puff of a buoyant plume, resolved into cells.

monolithics.name: Flame: Candle Cone
monolithics.desc: The quiet laminar burn of a wick, all its structure in the fine creases of the sheath.

monolithics.name: Flame: Blowtorch
monolithics.desc: Forced-air blue: the flame stretched thin and fast, streaks running with the jet.

monolithics.name: Flame: Backdraft Wrinkle
monolithics.desc: Starved, then fed — the front folds back on itself the instant the air arrives.

monolithics.name: Flame: Fire Whirl Grain
monolithics.desc: Rotation stretches every filament into the same handedness — a whirl written in grain, not in a spiral.

monolithics.name: Flame: Laminar Ladder
monolithics.desc: An orderly premixed burn: rungs of blue at a fixed spacing, cells filling between them.

monolithics.name: Flame: Crown Fire
monolithics.desc: Fire in the canopy — it stops running along the ground and starts leaping between crowns.

monolithics.name: Flame: Stoichiometric Seam
monolithics.desc: Emerald boron marking the exact ratio line where fuel and oxidiser are perfectly matched.

monolithics.name: Plasma: Arc Filament
monolithics.desc: Past burning: an ionised channel that carries current, not fuel.

monolithics.name: Plasma: Ionised Braid
monolithics.desc: Current and field braiding around each other down the length of the column.

monolithics.name: Plasma: Magnetised Jet
monolithics.desc: Copper-blue plasma collimated by its own magnetic field into a single hard direction.

monolithics.name: Plasma: Corona Grain
monolithics.desc: The violet haze at the edge of a charged surface, grainy right down to the pixel.

monolithics.name: Plasma: Streamer Web
monolithics.desc: Streamers branching ahead of the main channel, each looking for the easiest path.

monolithics.name: Plasma: Townsend Cascade
monolithics.desc: One electron becomes two, two become four — avalanche until the whole gap conducts.

monolithics.name: Plasma: Pinch Instability
monolithics.desc: The column squeezes itself, necks, and tears — sausage instability written across the surface.

monolithics.name: Plasma: Cathode Spot
monolithics.desc: Blinding white attachment points skittering across the electrode surface.

monolithics.name: Plasma: Glow Discharge
monolithics.desc: Low pressure, low current — an even green glow with visible striations in it.

monolithics.name: Plasma: Lichtenberg Burn
monolithics.desc: The fractal scar a discharge leaves behind, branching at every scale it can find.

monolithics.name: Plasma: Plasma Sheath
monolithics.desc: The thin charged skin that forms wherever plasma meets a solid wall.

monolithics.name: Plasma: Spectral Line
monolithics.desc: Apple-green barium emitting on one narrow line and nothing else.

monolithics.name: Plasma: Electron Avalanche
monolithics.desc: Every track a carrier multiplying as it runs; the surface saturates from the leading edge back.

monolithics.name: Plasma: Tokamak Ripple
monolithics.desc: Confined and stable — nested flux surfaces rippling in step.

monolithics.name: Plasma: Aurora Column
monolithics.desc: Charged particles following field lines down — curtains of green standing on end.

monolithics.name: Molten: Pahoehoe Skin
monolithics.desc: The ropy skin of slow lava, folding over itself as the crust drags on the flow beneath.

monolithics.name: Molten: Slag Crust
monolithics.desc: Waste glass floating on the melt, cracked into plates with heat still showing through the seams.

monolithics.name: Molten: Lava Cell
monolithics.desc: Convection cells on an open melt — dark crust above, orange shear at every boundary.

monolithics.name: Molten: Quench Craze
monolithics.desc: Hot glass into cold water: a craze network that keeps sub-dividing its own biggest fragments.

monolithics.name: Molten: Vitrified Glaze
monolithics.desc: Ash fused to a glassy skin, then cooled until it crazed — kiln chemistry, not paint.

monolithics.name: Molten: Weld Pool
monolithics.desc: The frozen ripple record of a moving arc, each crescent one pulse of the weld.

monolithics.name: Molten: Molten Drip
monolithics.desc: White-hot metal running and freezing on the way down, in hundreds of fine rivulets.

monolithics.name: Molten: Crucible Skin
monolithics.desc: Oxide plates lifting off the wall of a crucible, each curled at the edge and lit underneath.

monolithics.name: Molten: Basalt Column
monolithics.desc: Cooling contraction cracking a flow into columns — the same physics as mud, at 1200 degrees.

monolithics.name: Molten: Obsidian Chill
monolithics.desc: Cooled too fast to crystallise: black glass with conchoidal fracture running through it.

monolithics.name: Molten: Foundry Spatter
monolithics.desc: Thrown metal freezing where it lands, pocking the plate it lands on.

monolithics.name: Molten: Tuyere Glow
monolithics.desc: Looking in through the blast port: the hottest zone of the furnace, seen through moving gas.

monolithics.name: Molten: Slumped Glass
monolithics.desc: Glass gone soft and taken the shape it was resting on, the flow still legible in the surface.

monolithics.name: Molten: Magma Vesicle
monolithics.desc: Gas coming out of solution — bubbles frozen at the instant the melt stopped moving.

monolithics.name: Molten: Ropy Flow
monolithics.desc: Fast pahoehoe: the skin dragged into tight parallel ropes by the flow under it.

monolithics.name: Cinder: Ember Bed
monolithics.desc: What is left when the flame goes: a bed that is all heat and no light, breathing where air reaches it.

monolithics.name: Cinder: Ash Fall
monolithics.desc: Fine grey settling out of the air and building up wherever the wind lets it.

monolithics.name: Cinder: Soot Bloom
monolithics.desc: Carbon inception: dendrites branching out of nothing, the deadest material in the catalog.

monolithics.name: Cinder: Char Scale
monolithics.desc: Burnt skin gone to alligator scale, every plate lifted a little at its edge.

monolithics.name: Cinder: Cinder Lattice
monolithics.desc: The connected skeleton that survived — only the paths that stayed lit are still there.

monolithics.name: Cinder: Fly Ash
monolithics.desc: Spent particles too light to fall, drifting until they cool to nothing.

monolithics.name: Cinder: Coke Cell
monolithics.desc: Coal cooked without air until only the carbon cell wall is left standing.

monolithics.name: Cinder: Clinker Crust
monolithics.desc: Fused ash that went hard and vitreous in the grate — the stuff you have to break out.

monolithics.name: Cinder: Ash Glaze
monolithics.desc: Wood ash melted onto the pot by its own kiln and crazed as it cooled.

monolithics.name: Cinder: Dying Coal
monolithics.desc: The last of the heat retreating into the middle of each lump.

monolithics.name: Cinder: Grey Front
monolithics.desc: Ash advancing over ember — the moment a fire stops being orange.

monolithics.name: Cinder: Retained Heat
monolithics.desc: Cold on the outside, still dangerous in the core; convection barely moving above it.

monolithics.name: Cinder: Powder Burn
monolithics.desc: Residue of a fast burn: scorched powder with a few grains that never went off.

monolithics.name: Cinder: Spall Field
monolithics.desc: Thermal shock popping flakes off the surface, each leaving a paler crater.

monolithics.name: Cinder: Cold Ash
monolithics.desc: Completely out. Fine grey powder holding the shape of what it used to be.

monolithics.name: Ladle Pour
monolithics.desc: A pour that froze while it was still moving: laminar tongues under a wrinkled chill skin.

monolithics.name: Furnace Slag
monolithics.desc: Gas vesicles frozen mid-rise in a glassy crust, the way slag comes off the top of a heat.

monolithics.name: Sand Cast
monolithics.desc: The pebbled face a sand mould leaves, parting line still showing across it.

monolithics.name: Chill Ingot
monolithics.desc: Chill bands across the face of an ingot with the shrink pipe drawn down its middle.

monolithics.name: Forge Scale
monolithics.desc: Black scale lifting off hot iron, every flake curling at its edge.

monolithics.name: Planished
monolithics.desc: Planished by hand: overlapping hammer facets, each one a shallow dish.

monolithics.name: Damascus Fold
monolithics.desc: Hundreds of folded layers ground back, the ladder showing where the billet was cut.

monolithics.name: Face Mill
monolithics.desc: Overlapping cutter arcs, each pass stepping across the last.

monolithics.name: Lathe Turn
monolithics.desc: Concentric feed grooves running out from a chuck set off the panel.

monolithics.name: Diamond Knurl
monolithics.desc: The knurling wheel pressed a cross-hatch of pyramids into the bar.

monolithics.name: Belt Grind
monolithics.desc: Long parallel scratches with the odd deep one where a torn grit dug in.

monolithics.name: Weld Bead
monolithics.desc: Stacked passes of frozen ripple with the heat-affected zone tempering out either side.

monolithics.name: Plasma Cut
monolithics.desc: Drag lines raked down the kerf with dross still hanging off the bottom.

monolithics.name: Zinc Spangle
monolithics.desc: Hot-dip galvanising froze into big spangle crystals, every facet catching light its own way.

monolithics.name: Crucible Dross
monolithics.desc: The oxide skin pulled off the top of a melt, wrinkled and torn where the rod dragged.

monolithics.name: Cast Spatter
monolithics.desc: Droplets that flew, landed and froze where they hit, each flattened into its own splat.

monolithics.name: Teeming Stream
monolithics.desc: Metal falling from the ladle, drawn into ropes that thin as they stretch.

monolithics.name: Chill Shot
monolithics.desc: Atomised metal quenched into beads and packed into a bed.

monolithics.name: Bloom Iron
monolithics.desc: A sponge of metal and slag hammered together while it was never quite molten.

monolithics.name: Tuyere Burn
monolithics.desc: Where the blast hit, the metal ran and the refractory glazed into downwind streaks.

monolithics.name: Peened
monolithics.desc: A thousand overlapping hammer pits, the face work-hardened and dimpled all over.

monolithics.name: Anvil Face
monolithics.desc: Worn hollow in the middle and scarred by everything ever beaten on it.

monolithics.name: Drawn Taper
monolithics.desc: Stretched under the hammer, so the flats step narrower along the bar.

monolithics.name: Upset Bulge
monolithics.desc: Driven back on itself until it swelled, the metal folding in rings around the swell.

monolithics.name: Swage Block
monolithics.desc: Hammered down into a shaped die, carrying the die's flutes end to end.

monolithics.name: Fullered
monolithics.desc: The fuller drove a row of grooves across the stock to move metal sideways.

monolithics.name: Quench Check
monolithics.desc: Cooled too fast: the skin let go in a net of fine checks with hard metal between.

monolithics.name: Wire EDM
monolithics.desc: A field of microscopic craters, each one a single spark's worth of metal gone.

monolithics.name: Honed Bore
monolithics.desc: The cross-hatch a hone leaves so the oil has somewhere to sit.

monolithics.name: Broached
monolithics.desc: Every tooth cut a shade deeper than the last, so the wall steps in fine terraces.

monolithics.name: Shot Peened
monolithics.desc: Blasted with steel shot until the face is a mat of overlapping dimples.

monolithics.name: Cut Thread
monolithics.desc: A single helix down the bar with the tool's flank marks still in the flanks.

monolithics.name: Fly Cut
monolithics.desc: One tool tip swinging a wide arc, leaving the big scallops a surfacing cut is prized for.

monolithics.name: TIG Stack
monolithics.desc: Stacked dimes: every dip of the rod froze as its own overlapping disc.

monolithics.name: MIG Spatter
monolithics.desc: A fast hot bead with the spatter it threw stuck fast either side.

monolithics.name: Oxy Cut
monolithics.desc: Coarse drag lines with the slag that ran down them still welded on.

monolithics.name: Stitch Weld
monolithics.desc: Short runs with cold gaps between them, the way thin panel gets joined.

monolithics.name: Tack Row
monolithics.desc: A row of spot welds holding the job while the real welding waits.

monolithics.name: Undercut
monolithics.desc: The arc ate into the parent plate beside the bead and left a groove no inspector passes.

monolithics.name: Arc Strike
monolithics.desc: Where the rod touched off the joint and burned a bright scar into the plate.

monolithics.name: HAZ Bloom
monolithics.desc: No mark at all, just the temper colour blooming out from where the heat went in.

monolithics.name: Anodised
monolithics.desc: The etch left a fine directional grain and the dye sank into the pore structure.

monolithics.name: Rust Blued
monolithics.desc: Cards of black oxide grown, boiled and carded back until the steel went blue-black.

monolithics.name: Parkerised
monolithics.desc: A phosphate crystal coat, matt and grey and thirsty for oil.

monolithics.name: Copper Patina
monolithics.desc: The green climbing out of the low ground and eating its way across the metal.

monolithics.name: Powder Coat
monolithics.desc: The film flowed out but not quite flat, so it kept its orange-peel.

monolithics.name: Chrome Flash
monolithics.desc: Flash chrome over a substrate never quite polished out, mirroring every wave under it.

monolithics.name: Passivated
monolithics.desc: No coating to see — just the faint mottle the acid left behind.

monolithics.name: Mill Scale
monolithics.desc: Hot-rolled scale, blue-black and tight in places, flaked to bare steel in others.

monolithics.name: Phosphated
monolithics.desc: A heavy dark etch that bites deepest wherever the grain of the steel runs.

monolithics.name: Penrose Reliquary
monolithics.desc: Aperiodic five-fold rhombs that never repeat, leaded in jewel blues and violets.

monolithics.name: Ammann Vault
monolithics.desc: Eight-fold aperiodic squares and rhombs drawn in amber and teal behind brass came.

monolithics.name: Dodeca Choir
monolithics.desc: Twelve-fold quasiperiodic panes under an iridised film, hairline-leaded.

monolithics.name: Hex Apiary
monolithics.desc: A honeycomb of rolled amber glass in copper foil, every cell its own shade.

monolithics.name: Cairo Lantern
monolithics.desc: Interlocking pentagons in seedy lantern glass, bubbles caught in every pane.

monolithics.name: Rhombille Cube
monolithics.desc: Three rhombi to a hexagon: a floor of tumbling cubes that will not sit still.

monolithics.name: Lloyd Froth
monolithics.desc: Relaxed cells of near-equal size, like soap froth frozen and leaded in place.

monolithics.name: Gilbert Shatter
monolithics.desc: Cracks that nucleate, run both ways and stop where they meet an older crack.

monolithics.name: Truchet Braid
monolithics.desc: Triangular Truchet arcs braiding across the panel behind bevelled came.

monolithics.name: Wang Current
monolithics.desc: Edge-matched tiles whose colour runs continue clean across the whole panel.

monolithics.name: Girih Strap
monolithics.desc: Five-fold strapwork interlacing over glass cut to every polygon it leaves.

monolithics.name: Herringbone Hall
monolithics.desc: Planks of drawn glass laid herringbone and reinforced with wire.

monolithics.name: Shear Arcade
monolithics.desc: A leaded lattice that leans further with every course, like a hall seen at speed.

monolithics.name: Kagome Basket
monolithics.desc: The trihexagonal basket lattice: triangles and hexagons sharing every vertex.

monolithics.name: Snub Carousel
monolithics.desc: Squares pinwheeling between pairs of triangles, every cell twisted against its neighbour.

monolithics.name: Octagon Court
monolithics.desc: Broad octagons with a small square dropped into every crossing.

monolithics.name: Basket Weave
monolithics.desc: Pairs of planks crossing over and under in fours, foiled at every join.

monolithics.name: Triangle Choir
monolithics.desc: The plain equilateral net, every triangle slumped to its own thickness.

monolithics.name: Pinwheel Infinite
monolithics.desc: Conway's right triangles at one-to-two: subdivide, turn, repeat — no two panes point the same way.

monolithics.name: Sphinx March
monolithics.desc: The sphinx hexiamond, five triangles to a tile, marching by reflex substitution.

monolithics.name: Chair Recursion
monolithics.desc: L-trominoes that subdivide into four smaller chairs, and those into four more.

monolithics.name: Mondrian Cut
monolithics.desc: A guillotine cut every time: rectangles of every proportion, none of them lining up.

monolithics.name: Slat Stretch
monolithics.desc: Voronoi cells drawn out along one axis until they read as rolled slats.

monolithics.name: Delaunay Web
monolithics.desc: The triangulation of a scattered point set — every pane a triangle, no two alike.

monolithics.name: Bubble Raft
monolithics.desc: Hexagonal close packing with the dislocations a real raft always has.

monolithics.name: Mudcrack Pan
monolithics.desc: Mud dried until it split: stubby cells, every join meeting at ninety degrees.

monolithics.name: Crazed Glaze
monolithics.desc: The shrinkage net an old glaze crazes into, long cracks first and short ones after.

monolithics.name: Basalt Column
monolithics.desc: Columnar basalt in section: hexagons that cooled imperfectly and wander at the joints.

monolithics.name: Cafe Wall
monolithics.desc: Straight courses the eye insists are wedges, because every row is offset against the last.

monolithics.name: Zigzag Ribbon
monolithics.desc: Courses that fold back on themselves, chevroning all the way down the panel.

monolithics.name: Spiral Nave
monolithics.desc: Courses winding out from a pole set off the panel, so the leadwork sweeps instead of rings.

monolithics.name: Conformal Bend
monolithics.desc: A square lattice pushed through a conformal map: right angles kept, the grid itself bent.

monolithics.name: Moire Beat
monolithics.desc: Two grids at a hair of an angle: where they beat, the panes shrink to slivers.

monolithics.name: Zellige Star
monolithics.desc: The eight-point star and its cross, cut and set by hand.

monolithics.name: Mashrabiya Screen
monolithics.desc: A turned-wood screen: discs on a lattice joined by bridges, light coming through the rest.

monolithics.name: Muqarnas Vault
monolithics.desc: Stepped niches corbelling inward, every tier smaller than the one it hangs from.

monolithics.name: Woven Interlace
monolithics.desc: Every strand passes above one neighbour and below the next; the crossings are their own panes.

monolithics.name: Scalemail Coat
monolithics.desc: Riveted scale armour, each disc hiding the top of the scale below it.

monolithics.name: Fishscale Roof
monolithics.desc: Imbricated arcs — the oldest roofing pattern there is.

monolithics.name: Droste Well
monolithics.desc: The same lattice nested inside itself at every octave, opening into a smaller copy of itself.

monolithics.name: Fibonacci Course
monolithics.desc: Two plank widths laid in the golden order, so the courses never settle into a repeat.

monolithics.name: Laguerre Press
monolithics.desc: Voronoi with weights: big cells shoulder the small ones aside and the joins go crooked.

monolithics.name: Kite and Dart
monolithics.desc: Penrose kites and darts: the same pentagrid, offset to the singular value that splits them.

monolithics.name: Sevenfold Drift
monolithics.desc: Seven-fold order the plane cannot hold periodically, so the panes drift forever.

monolithics.name: Flemish Bond
monolithics.desc: A header and a stretcher alternating in every course — the bond that reads hand-laid.

monolithics.name: Jali Pierce
monolithics.desc: Pierced stone: an interlocking net of hexagonal openings inside a hexagonal frame.

monolithics.name: Hexstar Lantern
monolithics.desc: Six-point stars with the triangles they leave between them.

monolithics.name: Elongated Course
monolithics.desc: Rows of squares alternating with rows of triangles — two kinds of course in one wall.

monolithics.name: Impact Shatter
monolithics.desc: Radial fractures from strikes set off the panel, crossed by the rings each strike sent out.

monolithics.name: Athanor Slag
monolithics.desc: The glass that froze in the furnace mouth, gas vesicles caught mid-rise along a flow still moving. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Sulfur Crust
monolithics.desc: Botryoidal sulfur: spheroids budded on spheroids, needles sublimed out of the gaps between. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Herbarium Press
monolithics.desc: A specimen flattened onto rag paper a century ago: midrib, secondaries, reticulation, foxing. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Transmutation Seal
monolithics.desc: Concentric bands of ring text with the figure struck across them, cut sharp into the plate. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Verdigris Bloom
monolithics.desc: Copper corrosion spreading as colonies, each a crusted disc that grew until it met the next. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Apothecary Crust
monolithics.desc: A bottle left to evaporate: every level it stopped at is a ring, and the salt crystallised on each. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Vitriol Etch
monolithics.desc: Acid on metal: pits that ate outward along the grain, each fringed by the dendrites the reaction left. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Quicksilver
monolithics.desc: Beads that ran together and stopped: fat lenses joined by necks, tarnish creeping over the stillest. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Philosopher's Stone
monolithics.desc: The impossible packing: discs of every size nested into the gaps of the discs before them, each cut as a gem. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Cinnabar Druse
monolithics.desc: A vug lined with crystal: every termination a facetted point, all crowded into the same small space. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Blood Augury
monolithics.desc: A poured offering dried to a crackle glaze: the network of cracks is the reading. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Planchette Path
monolithics.desc: A spirit board worn by decades of travel, the letter blocks still there under the arcs the planchette polished. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Casting Bones
monolithics.desc: Knucklebones thrown and settled where they fell, packed tight, each knobbed at both ends. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Tasseomancy
monolithics.desc: Leaf fragments left in the cup, settled into the bands the last swirl of tea drew them into. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Palm Reading
monolithics.desc: Friction ridges flowing around the loops they grew into, broken where the major lines cross. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Astrolabe Plate
monolithics.desc: Almucantar arcs and azimuth rays engraved into brass, a star pointer punched at the crossings. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Ceromancy
monolithics.desc: Molten wax dropped into cold water, set as thin lobed sheets, holed and rimmed where it tore. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Black Mirror
monolithics.desc: A scrying glass knapped from obsidian, conchoidal shells rippling from every strike. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Ink Scrying
monolithics.desc: A drop of ink opening in water: sheets of filament pulled into each other, thinning to smoke. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Haruspex
monolithics.desc: The reading surface itself: lobes divided by their fissures, the vessel tree branching across every one. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Urn Slip
monolithics.desc: A burnished funerary pot: the pebble tool left its strokes, the kiln left its clouds. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Bog Body
monolithics.desc: Skin tanned by peat acid, the pore field still there, the whole hide creased where the bog folded it. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Coffin Varnish
monolithics.desc: Shellac gone alligator, hard plates of finish curling off the grain that still shows underneath. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Grave Wax
monolithics.desc: Adipocere: soft lobes set into each other, every surface crazed by a wax that dried too slowly. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Shroud
monolithics.desc: Loose linen with threads pulled out of it and the bloom of what soaked through. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Barrow Soil
monolithics.desc: The matrix an excavation comes out of: grit, root threads and the sherd edges that make the dig worth digging. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Bone Ash
monolithics.desc: Calcined to a crust, grains sintered into each other with the voids the burning left between. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Barrow Frost
monolithics.desc: Hoar crystals feathering off cold stone: a spine, side branches, and branches off those. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Ossuary Wall
monolithics.desc: Long bones stacked end out, packed with the small pieces that fill the gaps, every shaft showing its marrow void. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Corpse Candle
monolithics.desc: Tallow run down in curtains and set, wick soot blackening the runs it poured over. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Wendigo Horn
monolithics.desc: Keratin laid down in growth laminae around a curved core, split lengthwise where it dried. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Thunderbird Quill
monolithics.desc: Barbs combed off a storm-bird shaft, zipped by barbules and torn open where the vane parted. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Mothman Dust
monolithics.desc: Wing scales shingled in rows, each a ribbed paddle that comes off on your fingers. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Lake Serpent Scute
monolithics.desc: Keeled belly plates carrying the growth annuli of every year it swam, under a haze of shed skin. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Devil's Hoof
monolithics.desc: Horn wall in laminae, packed with the tubules that grew it, split down the cleft. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Sasquatch Pelt
monolithics.desc: Guard hair matted into locks, every lock combed by the same weather and clumped where it dried. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Chupacabra Spine
monolithics.desc: Dorsal spikes in ranks with the membrane still stretched between them, veined and torn. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Grendel Hide
monolithics.desc: Thick leather gone to warts, nodules of every size bedded in a cracked matrix and seamed where old wounds closed. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Kraken Sucker
monolithics.desc: Rings of chitin teeth packed down the arm, each cup a ring of dentition around a dark throat. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Deep One Gill
monolithics.desc: Lamellae stacked plate on plate in curved ranks, every filament combed by the water it last breathed. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Hexfoil Ward
monolithics.desc: Compass-scribed daisy wheels burned into a threshold beam to turn a witch back at the door. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Witch Bottle
monolithics.desc: Bent nails, pins and hair packed into buried glass to catch a curse before it reaches the house. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Binding Knot
monolithics.desc: An endless knot tied over and under itself so that whatever it holds can never be untied. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Coffin Nail Ward
monolithics.desc: Coffin nails driven in a ward grid, each head ringed by the bruise its hammer left in the plate. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Salt Circle
monolithics.desc: A poured salt line dried to a crust, throwing dendrites off every edge across black slate. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Poppet Stitch
monolithics.desc: Sackcloth closed with crossed sutures and studded with the pins pushed through the poppet. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Hag Stone
monolithics.desc: Flint bored through by water, hung on a nail so the eye it grew can watch the door. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Sigil Seal
monolithics.desc: Oxblood wax struck with a sigil die, every disc sagging into the skirt it cooled in. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Red Thread Cross
monolithics.desc: Crimson yarn wound over crossed rowan twigs, the ply twist running against the wind. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Iron Cage
monolithics.desc: Riveted strap iron crossed over a void, forge scale still flaking from the bars. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

monolithics.name: Abyssal Lens
monolithics.desc: Pressure-warped deep-sea glass with blue caustic lenses

monolithics.name: Afterimage Lacquer
monolithics.desc: Magenta and cyan light trails trapped under black clear

monolithics.name: Aerogel Fire
monolithics.desc: Weightless amber heat suspended in frosted silica

monolithics.name: Anamorphic Pearl
monolithics.desc: Elongated pearl interference that turns with the surface

monolithics.name: Anti-Gravity Foil
monolithics.desc: Levitating mint and gold foil planes with impossible shadows

monolithics.name: Arc-Weld Velvet
monolithics.desc: Blue arc scars crossing soft black velvet chrome

monolithics.name: Black Ice Orbit
monolithics.desc: Black ice rings and frozen orbital shear

monolithics.name: Bloomglass
monolithics.desc: Hot-pink glass blooms rising from cool translucent fractures

monolithics.name: Brunel Current
monolithics.desc: Copper engineering-current waves through black enamel

monolithics.name: Caustic Engine
monolithics.desc: Machined cyan caustics with deep dark engine cavities

monolithics.name: Ceramic Storm
monolithics.desc: White ceramic tension cracks carrying electric blue glaze

monolithics.name: Chiral Mercury
monolithics.desc: Liquid mercury spiraling differently on each side of the sheet

monolithics.name: Chromatophore
monolithics.desc: Living color cells blooming beneath a glossy skin

monolithics.name: Cinder Mirror
monolithics.desc: Mirror-black ash plate cut by incandescent cinder veins

monolithics.name: Coral Voltage
monolithics.desc: Electric coral growth branching inside clear pink resin

monolithics.name: Cryogenic Sunset
monolithics.desc: Ice-blue metal flash crossed by an impossible warm horizon

monolithics.name: Deep Time
monolithics.desc: Mineral time-lapse bands pressed into violet-black clear

monolithics.name: Dichroic Skin
monolithics.desc: Thin dichroic skin switching cyan, violet and hot gold

monolithics.name: Electric Ink
monolithics.desc: Conductive blue ink spreading in precise capillary rivers

monolithics.name: Ferrofluid Silk
monolithics.desc: Black ferrofluid spikes folded into violet satin

monolithics.name: Ghost Transmission
monolithics.desc: Pale transmission lines fading through smoked blue glass

monolithics.name: Hologram Metal
monolithics.desc: Hard metallic hologram plates with spectral refraction

monolithics.name: Cinder Pulse
monolithics.desc: Dark reactive microfacets with cyan, violet, and ember material travel

monolithics.name: Hologram Noir
monolithics.desc: Graphite optical lattice with controlled cyan, violet, and green travel

monolithics.name: Cinder Aurora
monolithics.desc: Cinder Pulse's lattice with black beside deep violet and glints of gold, cobalt, pink, forest and oxblood filling the spaces; hidden regions choose which class fires

monolithics.name: Cinder Oxblood
monolithics.desc: A tighter cinder lattice of black beside dark red and dark gold, glints of brass, teal, magenta and lime, a two-population spec of pinks and greens

monolithics.name: Cinder Abyss
monolithics.desc: A wider, rhombic cinder lattice of black beside navy and deep teal with amber, plum, moss, red and ice glints; the hidden pattern travels in four colours

monolithics.name: Hologram Ember
monolithics.desc: Hologram Noir's perfect squares on dark bronze, each split into a 3x3 micro-grid of its own hues, seeded with vivid colour squares and black ones, every sub-cell its own material

monolithics.name: Hologram Ice
monolithics.desc: Twelve-pixel silver squares in quadrants of cold prism colour, glossed, with tinted brights and navy-black darks; a sub-cell spec in eight tiers per channel

monolithics.name: Hologram Verdigris
monolithics.desc: Twenty-pixel squares on oxidised green, a 4x4 micro-grid of gold, teal and magenta in each, more darks, more brights, a spec that changes every five pixels

monolithics.name: Penrose Reactor
monolithics.desc: A five-fold quasicrystal lattice that never repeats: every polygon its own jewel tone, a wandering class of cells running chrome-hot so the lattice travels under the light

monolithics.name: Nacre Terrace
monolithics.desc: Thin-film interference on stepped aragonite platelets: true Newton colours computed from film thickness along spiral growth terraces, every platelet its own shade and material

monolithics.name: Caustic Loom
monolithics.desc: Light refracted through a woven micro-lens and photon-binned onto the paint: sinuous rainbow-edged caustic filaments over a teal and wine twill, glass where the light folds

monolithics.name: Ion Bloom
monolithics.desc: Violet ion flowers expanding through conductive midnight

monolithics.name: Laminar Magma
monolithics.desc: Thin orange magma lamellae moving under obsidian clear

monolithics.name: Luminous Carbon

monolithics.name: Azure Celestial

monolithics.name: Vermilion Fire
monolithics.desc: Crimson-and-gold dragon brocade with curling flame fields; the fire motifs trace into glossy cut-outs that breathe under sun.

monolithics.name: Abyssal Sea
monolithics.desc: Jade-and-aqua sea-dragon brocade with foam crests; wave and scale motifs gate the angle reveal.

monolithics.name: Imperial Gold
monolithics.desc: Radiant gold-on-lacquer dragon-scale damask; gold linework reads as metal, lacquer cells as glossy clearcoat.

monolithics.name: Storm Black
monolithics.desc: Black-and-silver storm-dragon brocade with lightning forks; moody dark ground laced with electric metal veins.

monolithics.name: Jade Empress
monolithics.desc: Carved-jade dragon brocade — translucent greens with white relief and gold; sculpted scale field.

monolithics.name: Frost Emperor
monolithics.desc: Ice-white and glacier-blue dragon brocade with snowflake and frost-fern motifs; crisp cool reveal.

monolithics.name: Bronze Relic
monolithics.desc: Antique bronze and verdigris dragon-coin brocade; aged-treasure patina with gold-leaf relief.

monolithics.name: Pearl Chaser
monolithics.desc: Red-and-gold dragons chasing flaming pearls; the pearls trace into glowing focal gems scattered across the body.

monolithics.name: Dragon & Phoenix
monolithics.desc: Interlocking dragon-and-phoenix medallion brocade in cobalt, crimson and gold; balanced duo reveal.

monolithics.name: Phoenix Fenghuang
monolithics.desc: Crimson-orange-and-teal phoenix brocade — sweeping eye-spot tail-feathers fanning every direction; gold linework on a dark ground.

monolithics.name: Jade Qilin
monolithics.desc: Jade-and-gold qilin brocade — scaled unicorn-beasts and cloud scrolls in all orientations; auspicious omnidirectional weave.

monolithics.name: Guardian Foo Lion
monolithics.desc: Imperial-red-and-gold temple-lion brocade — curly-maned foo dogs with coins and knots; ivory highlights flash as pearl.

monolithics.name: Vermilion Bird
monolithics.desc: Vermilion-and-flame-gold southern-phoenix brocade with ember motifs; fiery birds turning every way under sun.

monolithics.name: Black Tortoise
monolithics.desc: Black-jade-and-silver Xuanwu brocade — tortoise shells and serpents with water scrolls; deep moody ground.

monolithics.name: White Tiger Baihu
monolithics.desc: White-silver-and-gold Bai Hu brocade — black-striped tigers prowling all directions with wind curls and coins.

monolithics.name: Crane Garden
monolithics.desc: Pale-jade crane-garden brocade — red-crowned cranes, pine, lotus and peony; light airy ground for a softer reveal.

monolithics.name: Koi Ascension
monolithics.desc: Cobalt-and-gold koi brocade — orange-and-white carp swimming every way over foam swirls and coins.

monolithics.name: Pixiu Fortune
monolithics.desc: Antique-gold-and-jade Pixiu brocade — winged wealth-beasts amid coin showers; gold reads as metal, jade as gloss.

monolithics.name: Golden Toad Jinchan
monolithics.desc: Gold-on-lucky-red money-toad brocade — three-legged Jin Chan with coin strings and lotus; opulent prosperity weave.

monolithics.name: Old Glory Flux
monolithics.desc: Deep navy lacquer dusted with red-and-white star-flecks under a multi-directional color-shift sheen that travels red-white-blue as the car turns.

monolithics.name: Rockets Red Glare
monolithics.desc: Firework bursts of concentric red and gold rings on a near-black night field — the sparks flare mirror-bright only when light rakes the panel.

monolithics.name: Liberty Torch
monolithics.desc: Omnidirectional licking flame tongues in red, orange and gold over ember-black — wrapped torch heat that glows hotter at the tips in clearcoat.

monolithics.name: Eagle Ascendant
monolithics.desc: Dense gold-on-navy brocade of scattered feather and wing motifs at every angle — imperial eagle damask that catches gilt light from any direction.

monolithics.name: We The People
monolithics.desc: Aged parchment cross-hatched with an engraved banknote guilloche — debossed ink lines in every direction with a low scholarly sheen.

monolithics.name: Midnight Militia
monolithics.desc: Tactical matte multicam in muted navy, slate and olive blotches with fine deep grain — dead-flat, light-eating stealth patriot camo.

monolithics.name: Freedom Forge
monolithics.desc: Molten steel mid-pour — glowing orange cracks web across cooling gunmetal cells with white-hot sparks, the cracks blazing in clearcoat.

monolithics.name: Amber Waves
monolithics.desc: Rippling wheat-gold grain bending under crossing winds — soft sheen-corridors roll across the gold like sun on a prairie.

monolithics.name: Glory Chrome
monolithics.desc: Liquid show-chrome brushed in crossing directions and dusted with red, white and blue mirror flecks — a polished patriot mirror.

monolithics.name: Sparkler Dusk
monolithics.desc: Dusk-purple twilight scattered with comet-spark micro-flake — tapered spark streaks at every angle, each tipped with a twinkling white-hot flake.

monolithics.name: Ember Glass
monolithics.desc: Blood-orange candy laid over coarse silver flake, shattered by a crackle relief: the coat burns thin and fiery on every plateau and pools deep crimson-black in the crack valleys. Under track lights the crack web glows wet while flake glints spark across the faces.

monolithics.name: Glacier Core
monolithics.desc: Crushed-ice facets locked under arctic cyan candy: every angular shard tips its own way, the coat staying thin and bright on the faces while the fissures between shards flood deep sapphire. Edge glints flash along the shard lines like sun on broken ice.

monolithics.name: Abyss Lantern
monolithics.desc: A near-black deep-sea teal so thick the metal barely survives the dive - until light rakes across it and hidden lantern cells bloom out of the clearcoat like bioluminescence. Head-on it is abyss; at an angle the car is alive.

monolithics.name: Stained Aurora
monolithics.desc: A leaded stained-glass window poured over silver leaf: every flow-warped pane is its own jewel - ruby, amber, emerald, sapphire, violet - in deep candy glass that pools darker toward its lead border. Hand-rolled ripple catches the light inside each pane.

monolithics.name: Prism Veil
monolithics.desc: Banded thin-film interference orders drift like a torn veil over a near-black cherry base - amber, magenta and violet plateaus split by prismatic shimmer, with the order edges flaring under direct light.

monolithics.name: Oilforge
monolithics.desc: Oil-slick rings bloom in quantized Newton bands around scattered heat spots on brushed gunmetal - the brush grain changes direction patch to patch, and the ring crests flare while the heat centers pool with wet gloss.

monolithics.name: Tempered Dawn
monolithics.desc: Titanium weld-temper: straw, bronze, violet and blue heat bands trace curling weld paths across raw brushed metal, and the bead line itself flares like fresh chrome under direct light.

monolithics.name: Pulse Alloy
monolithics.desc: Concentric pulses ripple out from scattered impact points, every ring order snapping to a different hue - teal, violet, magenta, gold - before fading into brushed alloy with a soft pooled glow.

monolithics.name: Velvet Eclipse
monolithics.desc: Deep indigo velvet shot through with a molten-gold micro lattice — head-on it reads midnight, raking sun sets the gold pools on fire while eclipse coronas glow in the clearcoat.

monolithics.name: Wovenlight
monolithics.desc: An over/under ribbon weave of emerald satin and royal-violet mirror that flips color as the car turns — dive shadows give the basket real depth and light pools diagonally across the weave.

monolithics.name: Sovereign Flip
monolithics.desc: Three paints in one: matte oxblood, mirror champagne and glass-deep emerald candy split the body into fine inked territories — every sun angle shows you a different car.

monolithics.name: Static Bloom
monolithics.desc: Electric-cobalt micro-static, magenta filament streaks and amber soft blooms each claim their own territory, their own hue family and their own light behavior — a triple-personality finish.

monolithics.name: Aurora Travel
monolithics.desc: An aurora curtain that physically travels: glossy corridors cut across the teal-violet-magenta flow, so the live highlight slides through different hues as the car rotates, while curtain-edge filaments flare icy white under direct light.

monolithics.name: Saffron Circuit
monolithics.desc: Etched micro-circuitry in saffron, rose and ember: trace density steers the hue, the grooves polish glossy and pool dark candy, and every via dot glows wet under the clear.

monolithics.name: Quicksilver Garden
monolithics.desc: Liquid chrome overgrown with a garden of pastel cells — every cell grows its own mini color ramp in its own direction behind a mirror-bright rim, and each cell flares at its own angle as you drive.

monolithics.name: Emberline Drift
monolithics.desc: Folded dune ridges drift from gold through crimson into smoke; satin sheen lanes cross the dunes at their own angles while embers pool and glow in the clearcoat between the crests.

monolithics.name: Duomorph
monolithics.desc: Two hidden artworks on one car: orbital glyph rosettes flare in the metallic under direct sun, while sweeping ribbon arcs glow out of the clearcoat at glancing angles — the deep graphite paint only whispers both until the light picks a side.

monolithics.name: Nightbloom
monolithics.desc: Dusk indigo melting into plum, seeded from scattered night-sky anchors — and when low sun rakes the clearcoat, luminous petal-fan blooms open across the car that the paint itself only hints at.

monolithics.name: Magnetite Flow
monolithics.desc: Ferrofluid spike colonies frozen mid-pulse on wet black: the coat pools deep blue-black between the spikes and thins to bright steel at every crest, and only the spike tips spark when the sun hits them dead-on.

monolithics.name: Comet Parade
monolithics.desc: A deep-space violet-to-teal field crossed by three separate comet swarms — heads spark in direct light, long wakes drag bright and dark gloss lanes across the panels, and bow-shock crescents glow out of the clearcoat at low sun.

monolithics.name: GL 00 Control (Ghost Fracture)
monolithics.desc: GL 00 Control (Ghost Fracture) — GHOST LAB experiment — Byte-identical Ghost Fracture. Your reference — everything else changes ONE thing vs this. Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

monolithics.name: GL 01 Metal LOW (~150)
monolithics.desc: GL 01 Metal LOW (~150) — GHOST LAB experiment — PILLAR 1 TEST: metal dropped to the level our newer finishes use. If the purple stops jumping through, near-max metal is the body-color engine. Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

monolithics.name: GL 02 Metal MID (~185)
monolithics.desc: GL 02 Metal MID (~185) — GHOST LAB experiment — Pillar 1 dose-response: halfway. Tells us the metal threshold where color-jump starts dying. Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

monolithics.name: GL 03 Rough PASTEL (150-200)
monolithics.desc: GL 03 Rough PASTEL (150-200) — GHOST LAB experiment — PILLAR 2 TEST + the pastel doctrine on-track: roughness raised to the light-pastel band. If flashes go soft/hazy, low roughness is what makes them EXPLODE. Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

monolithics.name: GL 04 Rough MIRROR (30-60)
monolithics.desc: GL 04 Rough MIRROR (30-60) — GHOST LAB experiment — Pillar 2 the other direction: glossier than GF. Do flashes get even sharper/harder? Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

monolithics.name: GL 05 Clearcoat FLAT (no cells)
monolithics.desc: GL 05 Clearcoat FLAT (no cells) — GHOST LAB experiment — PILLAR 3 TEST: same metal+gloss but the carve is GONE (CC uniform 212). If gold still flashes but with no cell pattern, the carve is only the SHAPE; if gold dies, the carve is the engine. Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

monolithics.name: GL 06 Clearcoat SHALLOW carve
monolithics.desc: GL 06 Clearcoat SHALLOW carve — GHOST LAB experiment — Pillar 3 dose-response: carve amplitude halved. How much swing does the two-color travel need? Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

monolithics.name: GL 07 Clearcoat INVERTED
monolithics.desc: GL 07 Clearcoat INVERTED — GHOST LAB experiment — Cells swap polarity (carved becomes flooded). Should swap WHERE gold vs teal appears — confirms the cells choose which env color shows. Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

monolithics.name: GL 08 Cells MICRO (3x smaller)
monolithics.desc: GL 08 Cells MICRO (3x smaller) — GHOST LAB experiment — Structure scale: same recipe, 3x finer cells. Does fine structure shimmer instead of detonate? Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

monolithics.name: GL 09 Cells MACRO (3x bigger)
monolithics.desc: GL 09 Cells MACRO (3x bigger) — GHOST LAB experiment — Structure scale: 3x bigger cells. Do big panels flash harder but read blocky? Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

monolithics.name: GL 10 Full PASTEL recipe
monolithics.desc: GL 10 Full PASTEL recipe — GHOST LAB experiment — The round-5 pastel doctrine applied to GF geometry (rough 150-170, compressed carve 191-240). Head-to-head vs GL 00 settles whether pastel beats the original on track. Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

monolithics.name: GL 11 Clearcoat MAX carve
monolithics.desc: GL 11 Clearcoat MAX carve — GHOST LAB experiment — Carve amplitude pushed to the rails (cells swing 40<->250). Is more swing more magic, or does it clip into noise? Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

monolithics.name: Basalt Columns
monolithics.desc: Basalt Columns — FRACTURED MINDS color-shift base — Giant's Causeway columns end-on: hot and cold column clans, chipped sparkling rims, and onion-fracture rings giving every column its own radial flash signature. Assign as BASE, pick a color, CRUSH the brightness near black, daytime track.

monolithics.name: Penrose Quasi

Assign as BASE, pick a color, CRUSH the brightness near black, daytime track.
