monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Clockwork Dial: Watch-dial guilloche: jittered gold rosettes over spectral lathe rings on near-black — horology under a prism.

monolithics.name: Contact Bloom
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Contact Bloom: Newton-ring blossoms: thin-film interference rings with true Airy crowding around every contact point, overlapping into gardens.

monolithics.name: Data Etch
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Data Etch: Optical-disc data sectors: wedge fields of micro-tracks, every sector refracting its own order rainbow off the etched blocks.

monolithics.name: Diamond Fire
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Diamond Fire: Brilliant-cut scintillation: kite-facet fans with internal dispersion and white scintillation pins — ice with fire in it.

monolithics.name: Event Horizon
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Event Horizon: An accretion disk doppler-beamed for real: the approaching side burns blue-white, the receding side dims red, around lensed black cores.

monolithics.name: Flare Spectra
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Flare Spectra: Spectroheliograph corona: thin emission-line arcs in pure spectral colors leaping across near-black.

monolithics.name: Forge Heat
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Forge Heat: True Planck incandescence: hammered steel glowing through cherry-orange-white by actual blackbody color, slag flecks quenching dark.

monolithics.name: Fracture Polarized
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Fracture Polarized: Cracked stressed glass: fringe rainbows CROWD at every crack tip (true stress concentration), the fractures glassy black.

monolithics.name: Ghost Prism
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Ghost Prism: Double-exposure spectroscopy: an attractor motif and its R/G/B ghosts offset in three directions — spectral echo art.

monolithics.name: Grating Quilt
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Grating Quilt: Holo-foil patchwork: stitched tiles of hairline diffraction gratings at scattered angles — every patch fires its own color at its own angle.

monolithics.name: Interference Weave
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Interference Weave: Over-under thread weave where the moire beat phase decides every crossing's hue — textile interference.

monolithics.name: Jewel Box
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Jewel Box: Stained-glass shard mosaic with dispersed caustics caged INSIDE each facet — light trapped in a jewel case.

monolithics.name: Lathe Burst
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Lathe Burst: Overlapping spin-cut systems; hue follows the cut angle like light raking spun metal — holographic engine-turning.

monolithics.name: Liquid Crystal
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Liquid Crystal: Cholesteric liquid crystal under the microscope: fingerprint pitch bands cycling the wheel, dark disclination defects threading through.

monolithics.name: Magnet Flow
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Magnet Flow: Iron filings in spectral ink: hue advected along true dipole field lines arcing pole to pole.

monolithics.name: Mantis Strike
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Mantis Strike: Mantis-shrimp carapace: segmented armor plates each cycling its own spectral band, raptorial strike streaks in ember.

monolithics.name: Moire Silk
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Moire Silk: Two silk-fine line lattices a hair off angle: giant slow rainbow interference beats rolling over visible micro-threads.

monolithics.name: Nacre Tide
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Nacre Tide: Abalone growth terraces: wavy stacked layer-lines, mother-of-pearl travel by layer count, dark conchiolin seams.

monolithics.name: Oilfilm Rain
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Oilfilm Rain: Gasoline rainbow after rain: drain-streaked oil film, rain-impact ring sets, wet aggregate poking through the slick.

monolithics.name: Opal Core
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Opal Core: Full crystal opal: wall-to-wall play-of-color domains over milk glass, every domain flashing on its own schedule.

monolithics.name: Orbital Engrave
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Orbital Engrave: Interlocking orbital ring systems cut into black chrome, each system flashing its glint at a different clock position — sequential fire.

monolithics.name: Peacock Eye
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Peacock Eye: Peacock train: dense structural-color eyespots (cobalt heart, teal iris, bronze halo) over fine radiating barbs.

monolithics.name: Pressure Map
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Pressure Map: Meteorology in paint: cyclone isobar spirals cycling hue, wind-streak barbs combing between the cells.

monolithics.name: Prism Pool
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Prism Pool: Dispersed caustics in a midnight pool: every dancing light filament is itself a tiny spectrum, red bending wider than blue.

monolithics.name: Rainbow River
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Rainbow River: Spectrum as a fluid: hue advected along real currents — rainbow streams, eddies trapping whirlpools of trapped color.

monolithics.name: Redshift Drift
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Redshift Drift: Receding galaxies: streaks red-shifted trailing, blue-shifted leading, smeared along the expansion flow.

monolithics.name: Shatter Glass
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Shatter Glass: Tempered glass exploded: shard mosaic, each fragment refracting its own dispersion gradient, prism fringes at every fracture line.

monolithics.name: Singularity Lens
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Singularity Lens: A deep-field sky gravitationally smeared into Einstein arcs and rings around invisible dark masses, violet rim-light on the voids.

monolithics.name: Smectic Fan
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Smectic Fan: Smectic focal-conic fans: packed ribbed fan domains, each refracting its own slice of the wheel — polarized-microscope money shot.

monolithics.name: Smoke Chroma
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Smoke Chroma: Laminar smoke going turbulent, every filament carrying its slice of spectrum through the curl.

monolithics.name: Spill Metropolis
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Spill Metropolis: Gasoline rainbow on wet night asphalt: micro-aggregate, drain swirls, neon signs bleeding into the slick.

monolithics.name: Star Temperature
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Star Temperature: The HR diagram as a sky: thousands of stars each colored by its real temperature class — red dwarfs to blue giants.

monolithics.name: Stress Storm
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Stress Storm: A polariscope hurricane: dozens of colliding photoelastic stress fringes — real fringe-order physics, rainbow contours storming across dark glass.

monolithics.name: Swirl Supernova
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Swirl Supernova: The detailer's swirl-mark nightmare made cosmic: micro arc-galaxies on deep violet, dispersive star glints riding every arc.

monolithics.name: Tempered Ghost
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Tempered Ghost: The polarized-sunglasses car-window secret: a drifting lattice of quench-spot stress rosettes in rose and iris over smoked glass.

monolithics.name: Thermo Touch
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Thermo Touch: Thermochromic skin: heat blooms crawl through the LC spectrum (bronze-green-blue) over visible fingerprint texture — a touch-reactive heat map.

monolithics.name: Topo Rainbow
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Topo Rainbow: Survey-fine elevation isolines cycling the wheel over shaded relief — cartography as iridescence.

monolithics.name: Vhs Phantom
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Vhs Phantom: Analog video breakdown: scanline micro, tracking-error rainbow tears, chromatic ghost offsets — the haunted tape.

monolithics.name: Vinyl Groove
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Vinyl Groove: Record grooves at hairline pitch sweeping in from off-canvas spindles, tone-arm rainbows raking across the tracks, anti-static dust glints.

monolithics.name: Xray Bloom
monolithics.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Xray Bloom: A garden in body color whose vein SKELETONS detonate spectral at the flash angle — the flowers x-ray themselves.

monolithics.name: OKLab Flow Gradient
monolithics.desc: A perceptual OKLab sunset ramp drifting along a curl-noise flow — organic, never a dead-straight band. A GRADIENTS finish.

monolithics.name: Iridescent Gradient
monolithics.desc: Oil-slick holographic hue travelling the spectrum along a warped radial coordinate with thin-film sheen — iridescent metal film. A GRADIENTS finish.

monolithics.name: Ridged Contour Gradient
monolithics.desc: A warped deep-sea ramp quantised into smooth topographic contour bands with bright ridge-lines — a designed banded surface. A GRADIENTS finish.

monolithics.name: Mesh Bleed Gradient
monolithics.desc: Several aurora colour sources bleeding into each other so colour pools and flows — a multi-source gradient mesh. A GRADIENTS finish.

monolithics.name: Duotone Grain Gradient
monolithics.desc: A candy-chrome two-anchor OKLab ramp broken by fine ordered dither-grain so the transition shimmers with premium micro-texture. A GRADIENTS finish.

monolithics.name: Chromatic Aberration Gradient
monolithics.desc: The same warped miami ramp sampled at three per-channel offsets so R/G/B diverge into prismatic colour fringing — lens-edge chromatic aberration. A GRADIENTS finish.

monolithics.name: Spectral Sweep Gradient
monolithics.desc: A full-spectrum rainbow sweeping once along a warped diagonal, OKLab-smooth so the hues stay clean — a single flowing rainbow band. A GRADIENTS finish.

monolithics.name: Liquid Marble Gradient
monolithics.desc: Iteratively domain-warped royal-purple veins folded into stirred-paint marbling, read off a multi-hue OKLab ramp. A GRADIENTS finish.

monolithics.name: Moire Interference Gradient
monolithics.desc: Two crossed near-orthogonal wave fields beating into shimmering chrome-ice interference bands — a woven optical gradient. A GRADIENTS finish.

monolithics.name: Holo Foil Gradient
monolithics.desc: Fine repeated diagonal rainbow strips with a crossing sheen band — a holographic foil catching light. A GRADIENTS finish.

monolithics.name: Radial Burst Gradient
monolithics.desc: Molten colour swept by angle around a point with a bright radial burst falling off outward — a starburst gradient. A GRADIENTS finish.

monolithics.name: Hyperprism Supernova
monolithics.desc: 15-color mirrored prism wedges detonate through spectral shock rings, fine arcs, glints, short sweeps, rings and petal sparks.

monolithics.name: Aurora Reactor
monolithics.desc: 14-color reactor curtains drive cyan, emerald, acid-lime, violet and hot-pink aurora energy through a vertically turbulent field.

monolithics.name: Toxic Candy Nebula
monolithics.desc: 12-color candy gas clouds collide toxic lime, ultraviolet, hot pink, tangerine and electric cyan inside a warped nebula.

monolithics.name: Ultraviolet Solarstorm
monolithics.desc: 13-color solar shockwaves cross ultraviolet, magenta, ember, gold and ion-blue in asymmetric expanding bands.

monolithics.name: Chromatic Faultline
monolithics.desc: 15-color tectonic shelves split a complete extreme spectrum along luminous fault traces with crushed fine debris.

monolithics.name: Kaleidoscope Overdrive
monolithics.desc: 12-color stained-light cells fracture purple, cobalt, cyan, green, amber and coral into a nonrepeating overdrive mosaic.

monolithics.name: Spectrum Dragonfire
monolithics.desc: 14-color braided flame tongues climb from violet through magenta, scarlet, molten gold, cyan and blue-white heat.

monolithics.name: Digital Acid Rain
monolithics.desc: 11-color segmented acid rain cascades through black-green, toxic lime, laser yellow, cyan and hard digital blue.

monolithics.name: Quantum Carnival
monolithics.desc: 15-color five-axis quasicrystal interference throws the full neon spectrum into impossible carnival symmetry.

monolithics.name: Holographic Maelstrom
monolithics.desc: 13-color counter-rotating vortices shear blue, aqua, green, yellow, coral, magenta and violet holographic bands.

monolithics.name: Electric Coral Rift
monolithics.desc: 10-color ocean-cyan and electric-coral plates tear apart at a brilliant energized rift with fine local fracture marks.

monolithics.name: Neon Cathedral
monolithics.desc: 12-color nested luminous arches rise through violet, magenta, ember, gold, ion-blue and white-hot stained light.

monolithics.name: Plasma Oilspill
monolithics.desc: 15-color liquid topology folds cold blue, cyan, emerald, acid yellow, molten orange, pink and ultraviolet like energized oil.

monolithics.name: Candy Quasar
monolithics.desc: 11-color candy rays erupt from concentric quasar rings in violet, fuchsia, peach, gold, mint and crystalline blue.

monolithics.name: Laser Jungle
monolithics.desc: 13-color bioelectric vines weave jungle green, acid lime, cyan, cobalt, ultraviolet, hot pink and ember laser light.

monolithics.name: Infrared Glacier
monolithics.desc: 10-color faceted ice travels from abyssal blue through cyan-white into infrared peach, scarlet and frozen black-red.

monolithics.name: Prismatic Thunderhead
monolithics.desc: 14-color branching storm ridges ignite indigo, ultraviolet, magenta, orange, yellow, electric green and lightning blue.

monolithics.name: Solar Reef
monolithics.desc: 12-color cellular reef light blooms through ocean blue, turquoise, mint, sun-yellow, coral, hot pink and deep violet.

monolithics.name: Velvet Spectrum Crash
monolithics.desc: 15-color torn velvet ribbons slam violet, fuchsia, scarlet, orange, yellow, green, cyan and cobalt into layered color impact.

monolithics.name: Cosmic Heatmap
monolithics.desc: 11-color topographic energy terraces climb from midnight and cobalt through cyan, green, yellow, orange and red-hot cosmic peaks.

monolithics.name: Domain Coloring Singularity
monolithics.desc: 15-color complex-domain singularities are curl-warped into ionized folds, edged with fine spectral filaments and controlled mineral-neon color geography.

monolithics.name: Nebulabrot Ionstorm
monolithics.desc: 14-color orbit-density nebulae collide with spectral-silk interference, forming seeded plasma clouds, charged rims and fine ion channels.

monolithics.name: Superformula Starforge
monolithics.desc: 13-color superformula stars are interference-warped into forged petals, nested wave chambers, sharp ridges and glittering micro-arcs.

monolithics.name: Bismuth Colorquake
monolithics.desc: 12-color bismuth terraces interlock with Chladni nodal geometry, creating crystalline steps, seismic seams and fine resonant edgework.

monolithics.name: Stable Ink Supercurrent
monolithics.desc: 15-color stable-fluid ink is driven through a caustic current, layering turbulent plumes, refractive threads, flecks, rings and luminous wake lines.

monolithics.name: Electrostatic Candy Wells
monolithics.desc: 11-color equipotential wells bend across ridged terrain, producing candy-charged basins, fine field contours, spark arcs and high-voltage pinpoints.

monolithics.name: Ferrofluid Spectrum Crown
monolithics.desc: 14-color ferrofluid spike crowns mesh with a fine gyroid lattice, stacking magnetic peaks, spectral cells, razor ridges and micro-glints.

monolithics.name: Viscous Prism Fingers
monolithics.desc: 13-color viscous fingers refract through a Schlieren field, splitting into prismatic branches, pressure halos, short sweeps and fine capillary veins.

monolithics.name: Scarab Shingle Cascade
monolithics.desc: 12-color scarab-scale shingles cascade through caustic light, with fractured color flipping across fine overlapping plates, rims and spectral flecks.

monolithics.name: Nacre Brickwave
monolithics.desc: 12-color nacre bricks flow through a Gabor filament weave, building pearl tiles, fine mortar flashes, threadlike waves and opalescent edge shifts.

monolithics.name: Singularity Loom
monolithics.desc: 15-color conformal lattice is curl-woven into a singularity loom of pinched cells, fine braided currents, orbit rings and luminous crossing points.

monolithics.name: Harmonic Cathedral
monolithics.desc: 14-color harmonograph tracery rises through Chladni resonance, forming cathedral arches, stained spectral chambers, fine ribs and jeweled nodes.

monolithics.name: Split Underglow

monolithics.name: Signglass Shatter
monolithics.desc: Broken sign-glass territories with white-hot rims and dying phosphor interiors. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

monolithics.name: Seoul Circuit
monolithics.desc: Rounded luminous panel cascades and mint-lilac city-current seams. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

monolithics.name: Laser Lane

monolithics.name: Arcade Afterhours
monolithics.desc: Blacklight scan waves, vector sweeps and phosphor trails after closing time. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

monolithics.name: Toxic Overdrive
monolithics.desc: Acid-green current pools with yellow pressure lips and black sink regions. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

monolithics.name: Phantom Taillights
monolithics.desc: Red and magenta afterimage ribbons fading through midnight blue. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

monolithics.name: Turbo Heat
monolithics.desc: Anodized titanium heat zones, weld ripples and hot turbine seams. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

monolithics.name: Midnight Candy

monolithics.desc: A Ghibli sky-sea — stratified cel-shaded cloud decks with ink rims, sun stipple and tiny birds. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

monolithics.name: Impact Frames
monolithics.desc: Manga impact-burst cells — jagged spike outlines, B/W flash sectors, halftone interiors, yellow flashes. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

monolithics.desc: A blade blizzard — concave 4-point shuriken with spin trails, kunai, embed cracks, crimson ribbons. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

monolithics.name: Raiton Lightning
monolithics.desc: A dendritic lightning nest — stepped zigzag bolts, white-hot cores in cyan sheaths, mauve echo strikes. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

monolithics.name: Iris Gem Field
monolithics.desc: A field of anime-eye irises — radial fibers, limbal rings, jewel heterochromia, window catchlights. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

monolithics.name: Holo Idol Foil
monolithics.desc: Idol-sticker holo foil — warped rainbow interference, micro-prism facets, star and heart confetti. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

monolithics.name: Kanji Rain
monolithics.desc: Columns of brush-stroke glyphs raining down washi — sumi ink, vermillion accents, hanko seals. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

monolithics.desc: A comic sound-effect riot — jagged double-outline bursts, halftone shading, slash marks, action dashes. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

monolithics.desc: A sky multiplied with eclipse moons — cel-banded craters, bright rim arcs, crossing cloud wisps, flocks. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

monolithics.name: Oni Sumi-e
monolithics.desc: Demon-mask brushwork — dry-bristle horn and fang strokes, enso rings, ink mist, vermillion hanko. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

monolithics.name: Manga Page Chaos
monolithics.desc: An exploded manga spread — recursive panels, ink gutters, every panel a different screentone story. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

monolithics.desc: Thin-film interference over a flowing film — oil-on-water iridescence, glossy and shifting. Light & Optics finish.

monolithics.desc: The bright cyan caustic web focused on a sunlit pool floor, rippling over deep teal water. Light & Optics finish.

monolithics.name: Carbon Twill Weave

monolithics.name: Forged Carbon
monolithics.desc: Marbled chopped-carbon composite — flake shards at random fibre angles with micro glints in resin. Materials & Physics finish.

monolithics.name: Engine-Turned Metal

monolithics.name: Liquid Metal
monolithics.desc: Flowing chrome / mercury — a reflective metaball surface with mirror bands and capillary ripples. Materials & Physics finish.

monolithics.name: Crystal Lattice
monolithics.desc: A grown mineral bed — faceted crystal grains with bright cleavage edges and pin-point glints. Materials & Physics finish.

monolithics.name: Ferrofluid Spikes
monolithics.desc: Ferrofluid under a magnet — the Rosensweig spike lattice, black iron mounds with glossy steel caps. Materials & Physics finish.

monolithics.name: Fracture Net
monolithics.desc: A stressed brittle surface shattered into a bright crack network over subtly tilted plates. Materials & Physics finish.

monolithics.name: Damascus Steel
monolithics.desc: Pattern-welded Damascus — folded layers of light/dark steel ground back into a flowing watermark. Materials & Physics finish.

monolithics.name: Kevlar Aramid Weave

monolithics.name: Meteorite Widmanstatten
monolithics.desc: Etched iron-meteorite — interlocking kamacite ribbons crossing at the octahedrite angles. Materials & Physics finish.

base::rad_glass_block.f: A big pink and aqua cell mosaic with creamy white borders and a wet candy-glass shine; the colours and the sparkling glints stay, the flutes blur into soft stripes.
base::rad_glass_block.l: Satin with a strong mix of metal and gloss (M std 82, R std 47, C std 43): cells and seams respond very differently, so highlights slide along the flutes and the yellow glints flash as the car moves; in shade it keeps its pastel colours but loses the sparkle.
